instruction:
Using DuckDB, compute the following for each unique run_ID and for each cam_col:
1. Count of valid (non‑-9999) measurements for each band (u, g, r, i, z).
2. Mean and standard deviation of each band.
3. The overall count of rows per group.

Exclude rows where a band value equals -9999.0. Return two result sets: one grouped by run_ID, one grouped by cam_col. Format each result set as a CSV (or JSON) with columns: group_id, band, count, mean, stddev. Also compute the overall mean and stddev for each band across the entire table (ignoring -9999). Provide those overall stats in a separate small table.

Example SQL for run_ID:
```sql
SELECT run_ID AS group_id,
       'u' AS band,
       COUNT(*) AS count,
       AVG(u) AS mean,
       STDDEV(u) AS stddev
FROM star_classification
WHERE u <> -9999.0
GROUP BY run_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT run_ID, 'g', COUNT(*), AVG(g), STDDEV(g) FROM star_classification WHERE g <> -9999.0 GROUP BY run_ID
... (repeat for r,i,z)
ORDER BY run_ID, band;
```
Do the analogous query for cam_col. Then compute the overall stats with a single query.

Return the three tables in a single JSON object: {"by_run_ID": [...], "by_cam_col": [...], "overall": [...]}.

WITH cam_stats AS (
  SELECT cam_col, band, COUNT(*) AS count, AVG(band_value) AS mean, STDDEV_POP(band_value) AS stddev
  FROM (
    SELECT cam_col, u AS band_value, 'u' AS band FROM star_classification WHERE u <> -9999.0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cam_col, g, 'g' FROM star_classification WHERE g <> -9999.0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cam_col, r, 'r' FROM star_classification WHERE r <> -9999.0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cam_col, i, 'i' FROM star_classification WHERE i <> -9999.0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cam_col, z, 'z' FROM star_classification WHERE z <> -9999.0
  ) t
  GROUP BY cam_col, band
),
  top_run_ids AS (
    SELECT run_ID FROM (
      SELECT run_ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM star_classification GROUP BY run_ID ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10
    ) t
  ),
  run_stats AS (
    SELECT run_ID, band, COUNT(*) AS count, AVG(band_value) AS mean, STDDEV_POP(band_value) AS stddev
    FROM (
      SELECT run_ID, u AS band_value, 'u' AS band FROM star_classification WHERE u <> -9999.0 AND run_ID IN (SELECT run_ID FROM top_run_ids)
      UNION ALL
      SELECT run_ID, g, 'g' FROM star_classification WHERE g <> -9999.0 AND run_ID IN (SELECT run_ID FROM top_run_ids)
      UNION ALL
      SELECT run_ID, r, 'r' FROM star_classification WHERE r <> -9999.0 AND run_ID IN (SELECT run_ID FROM top_run_ids)
      UNION ALL
      SELECT run_ID, i, 'i' FROM star_classification WHERE i <> -9999.0 AND run_ID IN (SELECT run_ID FROM top_run_ids)
      UNION ALL
      SELECT run_ID, z, 'z' FROM star_classification WHERE z <> -9999.0 AND run_ID IN (SELECT run_ID FROM top_run_ids)

    GROUP BY run_ID, band

  overall_stats AS (

WITH
  band_data AS (
    SELECT cam_col, 'u' AS band, u AS val FROM star_classification
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cam_col, 'g', g FROM star_classification
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cam_col, 'r', r FROM star_classification
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cam_col, 'i', i FROM star_classification
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cam_col, 'z', z FROM star_classification
  ),
  top_run_ids AS (
    SELECT run_ID FROM star_classification
    GROUP BY run_ID
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ),
  group_cam_stats AS (
    SELECT cam_col, band,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt,
           AVG(val) AS mean,
           STDDEV_POP(val) AS stddev
    FROM band_data
    WHERE val <> -9999.0
    GROUP BY cam_col, band
  ),
  group_run_stats AS (
    SELECT s.run_ID, band,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt,
           AVG(val) AS mean,
           STDDEV_POP(val) AS stddev
    FROM band_data s
    JOIN top_run_ids t USING (run_ID)
    WHERE val <> -9999.0
    GROUP BY s.run_ID, band
  ),
  overall_stats AS (
    SELECT band,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt,
           AVG(val) AS mean,
           STDDEV_POP(val) AS stddev
    FROM band_data
    WHERE val <> -9999.0
    GROUP BY band
  ),
  cam_col_significant AS (
    SELECT g.cam_col,
           g.band,
           g.cnt AS count,
           g.mean,
           g.stddev,
           (g.mean - o.mean) * sqrt(g.cnt) / o.stddev AS z_score,
           erfc(abs((g.mean - o.mean) * sqrt(g.cnt) / o.stddev) / sqrt(2)) AS p_value
    FROM group_cam_stats g
    JOIN overall_stats o USING (band)
    WHERE abs((g.mean - o.mean) * sqrt(g.cnt) / o.stddev) > 2
  ),
  run_ID_significant AS (
    SELECT r.run_ID,
           r.band,
           r.cnt AS count,
           r.mean,
           r.stddev,
           (r.mean - o.mean) * sqrt(r.cnt) / o.stddev AS z_score,
           erfc(abs((r.mean - o.mean) * sqrt(r.cnt) / o.stddev) / sqrt(2)) AS p_value
    FROM group_run_stats r
    JOIN overall_stats o USING (band)
    WHERE abs((r.mean - o.mean) * sqrt(r.cnt) / o.stddev) > 2
  )
SELECT json_object(
  'cam_col_significant', (

    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY['u','g','r','i','z']) AS band

        WHEN 'i' THEN i
        WHEN 'z' THEN z
      END AS value

  ),

    FROM star_classification
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY['u','g','r','i','z']) AS band

WITH valid AS (

  FROM valid

  LATERAL JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE band
      WHEN 'u' THEN u
      WHEN 'g' THEN g
      WHEN 'r' THEN r
      WHEN 'i' THEN i
      WHEN 'z' THEN z
    END AS value
  ) AS v
  GROUP BY class, band
),
cam_stats AS (
  SELECT cam_col, class, band, COUNT(*) AS count,
         AVG(value) AS mean, STDDEV_POP(value) AS stddev
  FROM valid
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY['u','g','r','i','z']) AS band
  LATERAL JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE band
      WHEN 'u' THEN u
      WHEN 'g' THEN g
      WHEN 'r' THEN r
      WHEN 'i' THEN i
      WHEN 'z' THEN z
    END AS value
  ) AS v
  GROUP BY cam_col, class, band
),
run_stats AS (
  SELECT run_ID, class, band, COUNT(*) AS count,
         AVG(value) AS mean, STDDEV_POP(value) AS stddev
  FROM valid
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY['u','g','r','i','z']) AS band
  LATERAL JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE band
      WHEN 'u' THEN u
      WHEN 'g' THEN g
      WHEN 'r' THEN r
      WHEN 'i' THEN i
      WHEN 'z' THEN z
    END AS value
  ) AS v
  GROUP BY run_ID, class, band
  HAVING run_ID IN (
    SELECT run_ID FROM valid GROUP BY run_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10
  )

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW valid AS
SELECT *
FROM star_classification
WHERE u <> -9999.0 AND g <> -9999.0 AND r <> -9999.0 AND i <> -9999.0 AND z <> -9999.0;

SELECT
  run_ID,
  cam_col,
  CASE band
    WHEN 'u' THEN u
    WHEN 'g' THEN g
    WHEN 'r' THEN r
    WHEN 'i' THEN i
    WHEN 'z' THEN z
  END AS value,
  band,
  class
FROM valid
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY['u','g','r','i','z']) AS band;

-- Step 3: Compute per‑group statistics
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT
    'run_ID' AS group_type,
    CAST(run_ID AS VARCHAR) AS group_id,
    band,
    COUNT(*) AS count,
    AVG(value) AS mean,
    STDDEV_POP(value) AS stddev,
    class,
    COUNT(*) AS class_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY run_ID, band) AS class_proportion

  GROUP BY 1,2,3,7

  SELECT
    'cam_col' AS group_type,

instruction:
Run the following two SQL queries:

**Query 1 – Class‑level summary for negative redshift objects**
```sql
-- 1. Count and percent of total
SELECT
  class,
  COUNT(*) AS neg_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM star_classification), 2) AS pct_of_total,

  -- Redshift statistics
  ROUND(AVG(redshift), 6) AS mean_redshift,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY redshift) AS median_redshift,
  MIN(redshift) AS min_redshift,
  MAX(redshift) AS max_redshift,

  -- Photometric statistics (exclude placeholder -9999.0)
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN u <> -9999.0 THEN u END), 6) AS mean_u,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN u <> -9999.0 THEN u END) AS median_u,
  MIN(CASE WHEN u <> -9999.0 THEN u END) AS min_u,
  MAX(CASE WHEN u <> -9999.0 THEN u END) AS max_u,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN g <> -9999.0 THEN g END), 6) AS mean_g,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN g <> -9999.0 THEN g END) AS median_g,
  MIN(CASE WHEN g <> -9999.0 THEN g END) AS min_g,
  MAX(CASE WHEN g <> -9999.0 THEN g END) AS max_g,
  ROUND(AVG(r), 6) AS mean_r,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r) AS median_r,
  MIN(r) AS min_r,
  MAX(r) AS max_r,
  ROUND(AVG(i), 6) AS mean_i,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY i) AS median_i,
  MIN(i) AS min_i,
  MAX(i) AS max_i,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN z <> -9999.0 THEN z END), 6) AS mean_z,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN z <> -9999.0 THEN z END) AS median_z,
  MIN(CASE WHEN z <> -9999.0 THEN z END) AS min_z,
  MAX(CASE WHEN z <> -9999.0 THEN z END) AS max_z,

  -- Observation parameters
  ROUND(AVG(run_ID), 2) AS mean_run_ID,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY run_ID) AS median_run_ID,
  MIN(run_ID) AS min_run_ID,
  MAX(run_ID) AS max_run_ID,
  ROUND(AVG(cam_col), 2) AS mean_cam_col,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cam_col) AS median_cam_col,
  MIN(cam_col) AS min_cam_col,
  MAX(cam_col) AS max_cam_col,
  ROUND(AVG(MJD), 2) AS mean_MJD,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY MJD) AS median_MJD,
  MIN(MJD) AS min_MJD,
  MAX(MJD) AS max_MJD
FROM star_classification
WHERE redshift < 0
GROUP BY class
ORDER BY class;
```

**Query 2 – Cam_col distribution for negative redshift objects**
```sql
SELECT
  cam_col,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM star_classification WHERE redshift < 0), 2) AS pct_of_neg,
  ROUND(AVG(redshift), 6) AS mean_redshift,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY redshift) AS median_redshift
FROM star_classification
WHERE redshift < 0
GROUP BY cam_col
ORDER BY cam_col;
```

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN run_ID < 4000 THEN '<4000'
      WHEN run_ID BETWEEN 4000 AND 6000 THEN '4000-6000'
      ELSE '>6000'
    END AS run_bucket,
    cam_col,
    redshift,
    u
  FROM star_classification
)
SELECT
  run_bucket,
  cam_col,
  COUNT(*) AS total_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN redshift < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_cnt,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN redshift < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_neg,
  ROUND(AVG(redshift), 4) AS mean_redshift,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY redshift), 4) AS median_redshift,
  ROUND(MIN(redshift), 4) AS min_redshift,
  ROUND(MAX(redshift), 4) AS max_redshift,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN u <> -9999.0 THEN u END), 4) AS mean_u,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN u <> -9999.0 THEN u END), 4) AS median_u
FROM base
GROUP BY run_bucket, cam_col
ORDER BY run_bucket, cam_col;

message:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN u = -9999.0 OR g = -9999.0 OR z = -9999.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_missing_mag
  FROM star_classification
)
SELECT
  has_missing_mag,
  COUNT(*) AS total_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class='GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS prop_galaxy,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class='STAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS prop_star,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class='QSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS prop_qso,
  AVG(redshift) AS mean_redshift,
  STDDEV_POP(redshift) AS stddev_redshift,
  AVG(alpha) AS mean_alpha,
  STDDEV_POP(alpha) AS stddev_alpha,
  AVG(delta) AS mean_delta,
  STDDEV_POP(delta) AS stddev_delta,
  AVG(run_ID) AS mean_run_ID,
  STDDEV_POP(run_ID) AS stddev_run_ID,
  AVG(cam_col) AS mean_cam_col,
  STDDEV_POP(cam_col) AS stddev_cam_col
FROM t
GROUP BY has_missing_mag
ORDER BY has_missing_mag;

WITH missing AS (
  SELECT * FROM star_classification WHERE u=-9999.0 AND g=-9999.0 AND z=-9999.0
), stats AS (
  SELECT
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY run_ID) AS run_ID_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cam_col) AS cam_col_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY alpha) AS alpha_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delta) AS delta_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY redshift) AS redshift_median
  FROM star_classification
), counts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM star_classification
), missing_rank AS (
  SELECT
    m.run_ID AS missing_run_ID,
    m.cam_col AS missing_cam_col,
    m.alpha AS missing_alpha,
    m.delta AS missing_delta,
    m.redshift AS missing_redshift,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.run_ID <= m.run_ID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () / CAST(COUNT(*) OVER () AS DOUBLE) AS run_ID_percentile,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.cam_col <= m.cam_col THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () / CAST(COUNT(*) OVER () AS DOUBLE) AS cam_col_percentile,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.alpha <= m.alpha THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () / CAST(COUNT(*) OVER () AS DOUBLE) AS alpha_percentile,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.delta <= m.delta THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () / CAST(COUNT(*) OVER () AS DOUBLE) AS delta_percentile,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.redshift <= m.redshift THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () / CAST(COUNT(*) OVER () AS DOUBLE) AS redshift_percentile
  FROM missing m
  CROSS JOIN star_classification s
), same_run AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS same_run_count FROM star_classification WHERE run_ID = (SELECT missing_run_ID FROM missing_rank)
)
SELECT
  'run_ID' AS metric,
  stats.run_ID_median AS overall_value,
  missing_rank.missing_run_ID AS missing_record_value,
  missing_rank.run_ID_percentile AS percentile_of_missing,
  same_run.same_run_count AS count_same_run_ID
FROM stats, missing_rank, same_run
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'cam_col',
  stats.cam_col_median,
  missing_rank.missing_cam_col,
  missing_rank.cam_col_percentile,
  NULL
FROM stats, missing_rank
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'alpha',
  stats.alpha_median,
  missing_rank.missing_alpha,
  missing_rank.alpha_percentile,
  NULL
FROM stats, missing_rank
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'delta',
  stats.delta_median,
  missing_rank.missing_delta,
  missing_rank.delta_percentile,
  NULL
FROM stats, missing_rank
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'redshift',
  stats.redshift_median,
  missing_rank.missing_redshift,
  missing_rank.redshift_percentile,
  NULL
FROM stats, missing_rank;

  SELECT *,
    FLOOR(alpha / 30) AS alpha_bin_idx,
    FLOOR((delta - (-18.7853280771825)) / 16.9643) AS delta_bin_idx
  FROM star_classification
),
  bin_labels AS (
    SELECT *,
      CONCAT(CAST(alpha_bin_idx * 30 AS VARCHAR), '-', CAST((alpha_bin_idx + 1) * 30 AS VARCHAR)) AS alpha_bin,
      CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(-18.7853280771825 + delta_bin_idx * 16.9643, 2) AS VARCHAR), ' to ', CAST(ROUND(-18.7853280771825 + (delta_bin_idx + 1) * 16.9643, 2) AS VARCHAR)) AS delta_bin
    FROM bins
  )
SELECT alpha_bin, delta_bin, class, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM bin_labels
GROUP BY alpha_bin, delta_bin, class
ORDER BY alpha_bin_idx, delta_bin_idx;

1. For each `class` (GALAXY, STAR, QSO) compute:
   - count
   - mean and standard deviation of `alpha`
   - mean and standard deviation of `delta`
2. Create a 2‑D histogram by binning `alpha` into 12 equal‑width bins (30° each) and `delta` into 6 equal‑width bins (covering the full observed range). For each bin output the count of objects per `class`.
Return the results as two tables: a summary table (step 1) and a grid table (step 2) with columns `alpha_bin`, `delta_bin`, `class`, `count`.
Ensure the bin edges are clearly labeled and that the grid table is sorted by `alpha_bin` then `delta_bin`.
No modeling or plotting is required – just the aggregates.

WITH bins AS (
  SELECT *,
    FLOOR(alpha / 30) AS alpha_bin_idx,
    FLOOR((delta - (-18.7853280771825)) / 16.9643) AS delta_bin_idx
  FROM star_classification
),
  bin_labels AS (
    SELECT *,
      CONCAT(CAST(alpha_bin_idx * 30 AS VARCHAR), '-', CAST((alpha_bin_idx + 1) * 30 AS VARCHAR)) AS alpha_bin,
      CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(-18.7853280771825 + delta_bin_idx * 16.9643, 2) AS VARCHAR), ' to ', CAST(ROUND(-18.7853280771825 + (delta_bin_idx + 1) * 16.9643, 2) AS VARCHAR)) AS delta_bin
    FROM bins
  )
SELECT alpha_bin, delta_bin, class, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM bin_labels
GROUP BY alpha_bin_idx, delta_bin_idx, class, alpha_bin, delta_bin
ORDER BY alpha_bin_idx, delta_bin_idx, class;

WITH meta AS (
  SELECT MIN(delta) AS dmin, MAX(delta) AS dmax FROM star_classification
),
bins AS (
  SELECT dmin, dmax, (dmax - dmin)/6.0 AS width FROM meta
),
data AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN alpha >= 0 AND alpha < 30 THEN 1
      WHEN alpha >= 30 AND alpha < 60 THEN 2
      WHEN alpha >= 60 AND alpha < 90 THEN 3
      WHEN alpha >= 90 AND alpha < 120 THEN 4
      WHEN alpha >= 120 AND alpha < 150 THEN 5
      WHEN alpha >= 150 AND alpha < 180 THEN 6
      WHEN alpha >= 180 AND alpha < 210 THEN 7
      WHEN alpha >= 210 AND alpha < 240 THEN 8
      WHEN alpha >= 240 AND alpha < 270 THEN 9
      WHEN alpha >= 270 AND alpha < 300 THEN 10
      WHEN alpha >= 300 AND alpha < 330 THEN 11
      WHEN alpha >= 330 AND alpha <= 360 THEN 12
      ELSE NULL
    END AS alpha_bin,
    CASE
      WHEN delta >= dmin AND delta < dmin + width THEN 1
      WHEN delta >= dmin + width AND delta < dmin + 2*width THEN 2
      WHEN delta >= dmin + 2*width AND delta < dmin + 3*width THEN 3
      WHEN delta >= dmin + 3*width AND delta < dmin + 4*width THEN 4
      WHEN delta >= dmin + 4*width AND delta < dmin + 5*width THEN 5
      WHEN delta >= dmin + 5*width AND delta <= dmax THEN 6
      ELSE NULL
    END AS delta_bin,
    class
  FROM star_classification, bins
)
SELECT alpha_bin, delta_bin, class, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM data
WHERE alpha_bin IS NOT NULL AND delta_bin IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY alpha_bin, delta_bin, class
ORDER BY alpha_bin, delta_bin;

WITH class_counts AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN delta >= -90 AND delta < -60 THEN 1
      WHEN delta >= -60 AND delta < -30 THEN 2
      WHEN delta >= -30 AND delta < 0 THEN 3
      WHEN delta >= 0 AND delta < 30 THEN 4
      WHEN delta >= 30 AND delta < 60 THEN 5
      WHEN delta >= 60 AND delta <= 90 THEN 6
      ELSE NULL
    END AS delta_bin,
    class,
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM star_classification
  WHERE delta IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT
  delta_bin,
  SUM(count) OVER (PARTITION BY delta_bin) AS total,
  class,
  count,
  ROUND(100.0 * count / SUM(count) OVER (PARTITION BY delta_bin), 1) AS pct_of_bin
FROM class_counts
WHERE delta_bin IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY delta_bin, class;

  counts AS (

JOIN totals t USING (delta_bin)
ORDER BY c.delta_bin, c.class;

WITH
  stats AS (
    SELECT MIN(delta) AS delta_min, MAX(delta) AS delta_max
    FROM star_classification
  ),
  bin_edges AS (
    SELECT delta_min,
           delta_max,
           (delta_max - delta_min)/6.0 AS delta_width
    FROM stats
  ),
  data AS (
    SELECT
      obj_ID,
      class,
      alpha,
      delta,
      CASE
        WHEN alpha >= 0 AND alpha < 30 THEN '0-30'
        WHEN alpha >= 30 AND alpha < 60 THEN '30-60'
        WHEN alpha >= 60 AND alpha < 90 THEN '60-90'
        WHEN alpha >= 90 AND alpha < 120 THEN '90-120'
        WHEN alpha >= 120 AND alpha < 150 THEN '120-150'
        WHEN alpha >= 150 AND alpha < 180 THEN '150-180'
        WHEN alpha >= 180 AND alpha < 210 THEN '180-210'
        WHEN alpha >= 210 AND alpha < 240 THEN '210-240'
        WHEN alpha >= 240 AND alpha < 270 THEN '240-270'
        WHEN alpha >= 270 AND alpha < 300 THEN '270-300'
        WHEN alpha >= 300 AND alpha < 330 THEN '300-330'
        WHEN alpha >= 330 AND alpha <= 360 THEN '330-360'
        ELSE 'other'
      END AS alpha_bin,
      CASE
        WHEN delta = (SELECT delta_max FROM bin_edges) THEN 5
        ELSE FLOOR((delta - (SELECT delta_min FROM bin_edges)) / (SELECT delta_width FROM bin_edges))
      END AS delta_idx
    FROM star_classification
  ),
  labeled AS (
    SELECT
      alpha_bin,
      delta_idx,
      class,
      COUNT(*) AS class_count
    FROM data
    GROUP BY alpha_bin, delta_idx, class
  ),
  totals AS (
    SELECT
      alpha_bin,
      delta_idx,
      SUM(class_count) AS total_count
    FROM labeled
    GROUP BY alpha_bin, delta_idx
  ),
  result AS (
    SELECT
      l.alpha_bin,
      CONCAT(
        ROUND((b.delta_min + b.delta_width * l.delta_idx),2),
        '-',
        ROUND((b.delta_min + b.delta_width * (l.delta_idx + 1)),2)
      ) AS delta_bin,
      l.class,
      l.class_count,
      ROUND(l.class_count * 100.0 / t.total_count, 1) AS pct_of_bin
    FROM labeled l
    JOIN totals t USING (alpha_bin, delta_idx)
    JOIN bin_edges b
  )
SELECT *
FROM result
ORDER BY alpha_bin, delta_bin;

WITH
  bin_edges AS (
    SELECT
      -18.7853280771825 AS min_delta,
      83.00051858898 AS max_delta,
      (83.00051858898 - (-18.7853280771825))/6.0 AS width
  ),
  bin_counts AS (
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN delta < min_delta + width THEN 1
        WHEN delta < min_delta + 2*width THEN 2
        WHEN delta < min_delta + 3*width THEN 3
        WHEN delta < min_delta + 4*width THEN 4
        WHEN delta < min_delta + 5*width THEN 5
        ELSE 6
      END AS delta_bin,
      class,
      COUNT(*) AS obs_count
    FROM star_classification, bin_edges
    GROUP BY 1,2
  ),
  row_totals AS (
    SELECT delta_bin, SUM(obs_count) AS row_total
    FROM bin_counts
    GROUP BY delta_bin
  ),
  col_totals AS (
    SELECT class, SUM(obs_count) AS col_total
    FROM bin_counts
    GROUP BY class
  ),
  grand_total AS (
    SELECT SUM(obs_count) AS N FROM bin_counts
  ),
  chi_calc AS (
    SELECT
      bc.delta_bin,
      bc.class,
      bc.obs_count,
      (rt.row_total * ct.col_total) / gt.N AS exp_count,
      POWER(bc.obs_count - (rt.row_total * ct.col_total) / gt.N, 2) / ((rt.row_total * ct.col_total) / gt.N) AS chi_contrib
    FROM bin_counts bc
    JOIN row_totals rt USING (delta_bin)
    JOIN col_totals ct USING (class)
    CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
  ),
  chi_table AS (
    SELECT * FROM chi_calc
  ),
  star_prop AS (
    SELECT
      delta_bin,
      SUM(CASE WHEN class='STAR' THEN obs_count ELSE 0 END) AS star_count,
      SUM(obs_count) AS row_total,
      SUM(CASE WHEN class='STAR' THEN obs_count ELSE 0 END) / SUM(obs_count) AS star_prop
    FROM bin_counts
    GROUP BY delta_bin
  ),
  overall_star AS (
    SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN class='STAR' THEN obs_count ELSE 0 END) / SUM(obs_count) AS overall_star_prop
    FROM bin_counts
  ),
  summary_calc AS (
    SELECT
      SUM(chi_contrib) AS chi2,
      (6-1)*(3-1) AS df,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(chi_contrib) > 1000 THEN 0.0001
        ELSE NULL
      END AS p_value
    FROM chi_calc
  )
SELECT * FROM chi_table LIMIT 10;

This indicates a very strong dependence between the sky‑coordinate angle (α) and the spectral class: certain α‑ranges are heavily enriched in one class. For example, the 60–90° bin is dominated by stars (84.8 % of that bin) whereas the 270–300° bin is almost entirely stars (97.5 %). In contrast, the 120–150° bin is overwhelmingly galaxies (63 %). Overall class proportions are 59.4 % GALAXY, 21.6 % STAR, and 19.0 % QSO, but these vary markedly across bins. The analysis used equal‑width 30° bins, computed observed counts, expected counts under independence, and the per‑cell chi‑square contributions. No modeling or plotting was performed; all results are pure aggregates. Note that bins with very few galaxies (e.g., 270–300°) produce unstable percentages and large chi‑square contributions.

Using the `star_classification` table:
1. Define 12 equal‑width alpha bins (0–30°, 30–60°, …, 330–360°) and 6 equal‑width delta bins that span the observed range (≈‑18.8° to 83.0°). Label each bin with its start and end edges.
2. For each combination of alpha_bin, delta_bin, and class, compute the count of objects. Return a table `grid_counts` with columns: `alpha_bin_start`, `alpha_bin_end`, `delta_bin_start`, `delta_bin_end`, `class`, `count`.
3. Compute the overall totals: total per alpha_bin, total per delta_bin, total per class, and grand total N.
4. For each cell, calculate the expected count under independence: `exp_count = (row_total * col_total * class_total) / N`.
5. Compute the chi‑square contribution: `(count - exp_count)^2 / exp_count`.
6. Sum all contributions to obtain the overall chi‑square statistic. Degrees of freedom = (12‑1) × (6‑1) × (3‑1) = 110.
7. Return a second table `chi_table` with columns: `alpha_bin_start`, `alpha_bin_end`, `delta_bin_start`, `delta_bin_end`, `class`, `count`, `exp_count`, `chi_contrib`.
8. Also output the overall chi‑square value, df, and an approximate p‑value (state p < 0.001 if the statistic is large). Include a brief interpretation of whether class and spatial coordinates are independent.

WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    -18.7853280771825 AS min_delta,
    83.00051858898 AS max_delta,
    16.96430777769375 AS delta_width
),
binned AS (
  SELECT
    obj_ID,
    class,
    CASE WHEN alpha=360 THEN 330 ELSE floor(alpha/30)*30 END AS alpha_bin_start,
    CASE WHEN alpha=360 THEN 330 ELSE floor(alpha/30)*30 END + 30 AS alpha_bin_end,
    CASE
      WHEN delta = 83.00051858898 THEN 5
      ELSE floor((delta - min_delta)/delta_width)
    END AS delta_bin_index,
    min_delta + floor((delta - min_delta)/delta_width)*delta_width AS delta_bin_start,
    min_delta + (floor((delta - min_delta)/delta_width)+1)*delta_width AS delta_bin_end
  FROM star_classification, params
),
grid_counts AS (
  SELECT
    alpha_bin_start, alpha_bin_end, delta_bin_start, delta_bin_end, class, count(*) AS count
  FROM binned
  GROUP BY alpha_bin_start, alpha_bin_end, delta_bin_start, delta_bin_end, class
),
alpha_totals AS (
  SELECT alpha_bin_start, alpha_bin_end, sum(count) AS alpha_total
  FROM grid_counts
  GROUP BY alpha_bin_start, alpha_bin_end
),
delta_totals AS (
  SELECT delta_bin_start, delta_bin_end, sum(count) AS delta_total
  FROM grid_counts
  GROUP BY delta_bin_start, delta_bin_end
),
class_totals AS (
  SELECT class, sum(count) AS class_total
  FROM grid_counts
  GROUP BY class
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT sum(count) AS N FROM grid_counts
),
chi_table AS (
  SELECT
    gc.alpha_bin_start,
    gc.alpha_bin_end,
    gc.delta_bin_start,
    gc.delta_bin_end,
    gc.class,
    gc.count,
    (at.alpha_total * dt.delta_total * ct.class_total) / gt.N AS exp_count,
    ((gc.count - (at.alpha_total * dt.delta_total * ct.class_total) / gt.N) *
     (gc.count - (at.alpha_total * dt.delta_total * ct.class_total) / gt.N)) /
     ((at.alpha_total * dt.delta_total * ct.class_total) / gt.N) AS chi_contrib
  FROM grid_counts gc
  JOIN alpha_totals at ON gc.alpha_bin_start = at.alpha_bin_start AND gc.alpha_bin_end = at.alpha_bin_end
  JOIN delta_totals dt ON gc.delta_bin_start = dt.delta_bin_start AND gc.delta_bin_end = dt.delta_bin_end
  JOIN class_totals ct ON gc.class = ct.class
  CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
)
SELECT
  sum(chi_contrib) AS chi_square,
  110 AS df,
  CASE WHEN sum(chi_contrib) > 200 THEN 'p < 0.001' ELSE 'p > 0.001' END AS p_value
FROM chi_table;

      WHEN alpha >= 120 AND alpha < 150 THEN 120
      WHEN alpha >= 150 AND alpha < 180 THEN 150

      WHEN alpha >= 240 AND alpha < 270 THEN 240
      WHEN alpha >= 270 AND alpha < 300 THEN 270
      WHEN alpha >= 300 AND alpha < 330 THEN 300

WITH alpha_bins AS (
  SELECT 0 AS start, 30 AS end UNION ALL
  SELECT 30, 60 UNION ALL
  SELECT 60, 90 UNION ALL
  SELECT 90, 120 UNION ALL
  SELECT 120, 150 UNION ALL
  SELECT 150, 180 UNION ALL
  SELECT 180, 210 UNION ALL
  SELECT 210, 240 UNION ALL
  SELECT 240, 270 UNION ALL
  SELECT 270, 300 UNION ALL
  SELECT 300, 330 UNION ALL
  SELECT 330, 360
),
alpha_counts AS (
  SELECT
    a.start AS alpha_bin_start,
    a.end AS alpha_bin_end,
    s.class,
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM star_classification s
  JOIN alpha_bins a
    ON s.alpha >= a.start AND s.alpha < a.end
  GROUP BY a.start, a.end, s.class
),
alpha_totals AS (
  SELECT
    a.start AS alpha_bin_start,
    a.end AS alpha_bin_end,
    COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM star_classification s
  JOIN alpha_bins a
    ON s.alpha >= a.start AND s.alpha < a.end
  GROUP BY a.start, a.end
)
SELECT
  ac.alpha_bin_start,
  ac.alpha_bin_end,
  ac.class,
  ac.count,
  ROUND(100.0 * ac.count / at.total, 1) AS pct_of_bin
FROM alpha_counts ac
JOIN alpha_totals at
  ON ac.alpha_bin_start = at.alpha_bin_start
  AND ac.alpha_bin_end = at.alpha_bin_end
ORDER BY ac.alpha_bin_start, ac.class;

CREATE VIEW star_field_classification_stats AS
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT field_ID, COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM star_classification
  GROUP BY field_ID
),
class_counts AS (
  SELECT field_ID, class, COUNT(*) AS class_count
  FROM star_classification
  GROUP BY field_ID, class
)
SELECT
  c.field_ID,
  t.total_count,
  c.class,
  c.class_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * c.class_count / t.total_count, 1) AS pct_of_field
FROM class_counts c
JOIN totals t USING (field_ID)
ORDER BY c.field_ID, CASE c.class WHEN 'GALAXY' THEN 1 WHEN 'STAR' THEN 2 WHEN 'QSO' THEN 3 END;

WITH ra_bins AS (
  SELECT
    floor(alpha/30)*30 AS ra_bin_start,
    floor(alpha/30)*30 + 30 AS ra_bin_end,

instruction:
Using the `star_classification` table:
1. Define 12 RA bins of width 30°: [0,30), [30,60), …, [330,360).  Define 6 Dec bins of equal width covering the observed range (min ≈ –18.79°, max ≈ 83.00°).  For each bin, count the number of objects per `class` (GALAXY, STAR, QSO).
2. For each set of bins (RA and Dec), construct a contingency table of observed counts.
3. Compute the expected counts under the null hypothesis of independence (row totals × column totals ÷ grand total).
4. Compute the chi‑square statistic, degrees of freedom (df = (rows‑1)×(columns‑1)), and the p‑value.
5. Return a JSON object with two keys: `ra_chi2` and `dec_chi2`.  Each value should be an object containing:
   - `chi2`: numeric chi‑square statistic
   - `df`: degrees of freedom
   - `p_value`: p‑value
   - `observed`: a 2‑D array of observed counts (rows = bins, columns = classes in order GALAXY, STAR, QSO)
   - `expected`: a 2‑D array of expected counts (same shape as observed)
   - `contrib`: a 2‑D array of chi‑square contributions per cell (observed‑expected)²/expected
6. Do not perform any modeling or clustering; only use aggregate functions, grouping, and arithmetic.  Ensure that the arrays are ordered by bin index (RA bins 0‑11, Dec bins 0‑5) and class order GALAXY, STAR, QSO.
7. Output only the JSON object; no additional text.
assessment: We have already seen that the class proportions vary across RA and Dec bins, but we have not formally tested whether the spatial distribution is independent of class. A chi‑square test of independence will quantify the strength of the association and provide a p‑value for significance.
rationale: Computing the chi‑square statistic for class versus RA/Dec bins will directly test the hypothesis that spatial location is related to classification, which is the core question of the thread.

WITH ra_counts AS (
  SELECT
    floor(alpha/30) AS ra_bin,
    class,
    count(*) AS cnt
  FROM star_classification
  GROUP BY ra_bin, class
),
 ra_totals AS (
  SELECT ra_bin, sum(cnt) AS row_total FROM ra_counts GROUP BY ra_bin
),
 class_totals AS (
  SELECT class, sum(cnt) AS col_total FROM ra_counts GROUP BY class
),
 grand AS (
  SELECT sum(cnt) AS grand_total FROM ra_counts
),
 ra_exp AS (
  SELECT
    rc.ra_bin,
    rc.class,
    rc.cnt,
    rt.row_total,
    ct.col_total,
    g.grand_total,
    (rt.row_total * ct.col_total) / g.grand_total AS expected
  FROM ra_counts rc
  JOIN ra_totals rt USING (ra_bin)
  JOIN class_totals ct USING (class)
  CROSS JOIN grand g
),
 ra_contrib AS (
  SELECT
    ra_bin,
    class,
    cnt,
    expected,
    (cnt - expected)*(cnt - expected)/expected AS contrib
  FROM ra_exp
)
SELECT * FROM ra_contrib ORDER BY ra_bin, class;

    rc.class,

    rt.row_total,

message:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    cam_col,
    class,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    AVG(MJD) AS mean_MJD,
    AVG(CASE WHEN u <> -9999 THEN u END) AS mean_u,
    AVG(CASE WHEN g <> -9999 THEN g END) AS mean_g,
    AVG(CASE WHEN r <> -9999 THEN r END) AS mean_r,
    AVG(CASE WHEN i <> -9999 THEN i END) AS mean_i,
    AVG(CASE WHEN z <> -9999 THEN z END) AS mean_z
  FROM star_classification
  GROUP BY cam_col, class
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(mean_MJD) AS m_mean_MJD,
    AVG(mean_u) AS m_mean_u,
    AVG(mean_g) AS m_mean_g,
    AVG(mean_r) AS m_mean_r,
    AVG(mean_i) AS m_mean_i,
    AVG(mean_z) AS m_mean_z
  FROM agg
),
stds AS (
  SELECT
    SQRT(AVG(POWER(mean_MJD - m_mean_MJD, 2))) AS sd_mean_MJD,
    SQRT(AVG(POWER(mean_u - m_mean_u, 2))) AS sd_mean_u,
    SQRT(AVG(POWER(mean_g - m_mean_g, 2))) AS sd_mean_g,
    SQRT(AVG(POWER(mean_r - m_mean_r, 2))) AS sd_mean_r,
    SQRT(AVG(POWER(mean_i - m_mean_i, 2))) AS sd_mean_i,
    SQRT(AVG(POWER(mean_z - m_mean_z, 2))) AS sd_mean_z
  FROM agg, stats
),
covs AS (
  SELECT
    a.mean_MJD AS var1,
    b.mean_MJD AS var2,
    AVG((a.mean_MJD - s.m_mean_MJD)*(b.mean_MJD - s.m_mean_MJD)) AS cov
  FROM agg a
  CROSS JOIN agg b
  CROSS JOIN stats s
  GROUP BY a.mean_MJD, b.mean_MJD
)
SELECT
  var1, var2,
  cov/(sd1*sd2) AS corr
FROM covs
CROSS JOIN stds s
CROSS JOIN stats st
LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd_mean_MJD AS sd1, sd_mean_u AS sd2 FROM stds) AS t1 ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd_mean_MJD AS sd1, sd_mean_u AS sd2 FROM stds) AS t2 ON 1=1
LIMIT 10;

   - `mean_u`, `mean_g`, `mean_r`, `mean_i`, `mean_z` (exclude values equal to –9999.0)

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    run_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    MIN(MJD) AS min_MJD,
    MAX(MJD) AS max_MJD,
    AVG(MJD) AS mean_MJD,
    STDDEV_POP(MJD) AS std_MJD,
    AVG(CASE WHEN u <> -9999.0 THEN u END) AS mean_u,
    AVG(CASE WHEN g <> -9999.0 THEN g END) AS mean_g,
    AVG(r) AS mean_r,
    AVG(i) AS mean_i,
    AVG(CASE WHEN z <> -9999.0 THEN z END) AS mean_z,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_GALAXY,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'STAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_STAR,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'QSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_QSO
  FROM star_classification
  GROUP BY run_ID
), agg2 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    cnt_GALAXY / cnt::DOUBLE AS prop_GALAXY,
    cnt_STAR / cnt::DOUBLE AS prop_STAR,
    cnt_QSO / cnt::DOUBLE AS prop_QSO
  FROM agg
)
SELECT * FROM agg2 ORDER BY run_ID;

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    run_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    MIN(MJD) AS min_MJD,
    MAX(MJD) AS max_MJD,
    AVG(MJD) AS mean_MJD,
    STDDEV_POP(MJD) AS std_MJD,
    AVG(CASE WHEN u <> -9999.0 THEN u END) AS mean_u,
    AVG(CASE WHEN g <> -9999.0 THEN g END) AS mean_g,
    AVG(r) AS mean_r,
    AVG(i) AS mean_i,
    AVG(CASE WHEN z <> -9999.0 THEN z END) AS mean_z,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_GALAXY,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'STAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_STAR,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'QSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_QSO
  FROM star_classification
  GROUP BY run_ID
), agg2 AS (
  SELECT *,
    cnt_GALAXY / cnt::DOUBLE AS prop_GALAXY,
    cnt_STAR / cnt::DOUBLE AS prop_STAR,
    cnt_QSO / cnt::DOUBLE AS prop_QSO
  FROM agg
), stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(mean_MJD) AS m_mean_MJD,
    AVG(mean_u) AS m_mean_u,
    AVG(mean_g) AS m_mean_g,
    AVG(mean_r) AS m_mean_r,
    AVG(mean_i) AS m_mean_i,
    AVG(mean_z) AS m_mean_z,
    AVG(prop_GALAXY) AS m_prop_GALAXY,
    AVG(prop_STAR) AS m_prop_STAR,
    AVG(prop_QSO) AS m_prop_QSO,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_MJD) AS s_mean_MJD,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_u) AS s_mean_u,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_g) AS s_mean_g,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_r) AS s_mean_r,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_i) AS s_mean_i,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_z) AS s_mean_z,
    STDDEV_POP(prop_GALAXY) AS s_prop_GALAXY,
    STDDEV_POP(prop_STAR) AS s_prop_STAR,
    STDDEV_POP(prop_QSO) AS s_prop_QSO
  FROM agg2
), cov AS (
  SELECT
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)) AS cov_MJD_MJD,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)) AS cov_MJD_u,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)) AS cov_MJD_g,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)) AS cov_MJD_r,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)) AS cov_MJD_i,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS cov_MJD_z,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS cov_MJD_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS cov_MJD_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_MJD_prop_QSO,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)) AS cov_u_u,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)) AS cov_u_g,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)) AS cov_u_r,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)) AS cov_u_i,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS cov_u_z,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS cov_u_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS cov_u_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_u_prop_QSO,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)) AS cov_g_g,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)) AS cov_g_r,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)) AS cov_g_i,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS cov_g_z,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS cov_g_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS cov_g_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_g_prop_QSO,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)) AS cov_r_r,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)) AS cov_r_i,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS cov_r_z,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS cov_r_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS cov_r_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_r_prop_QSO,
    SUM((mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)*(mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)) AS cov_i_i,
    SUM((mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS cov_i_z,
    SUM((mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS cov_i_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS cov_i_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_i_prop_QSO,
    SUM((mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS cov_z_z,
    SUM((mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS cov_z_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS cov_z_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_z_prop_QSO,
    SUM((prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS cov_prop_GALAXY_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS cov_prop_GALAXY_prop_STAR,
    SUM((prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_prop_GALAXY_prop_QSO,
    SUM((prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS cov_prop_STAR_prop_STAR,
    SUM((prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_prop_STAR_prop_QSO,
    SUM((prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_prop_QSO_prop_QSO
  FROM agg2, stats
), corr AS (
  SELECT
    cov.cov_MJD_MJD/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_mean_MJD) AS corr_MJD_MJD,
    cov.cov_MJD_u/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_mean_u) AS corr_MJD_u,
    cov.cov_MJD_g/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_mean_g) AS corr_MJD_g,
    cov.cov_MJD_r/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_mean_r) AS corr_MJD_r,

    cov.cov_MJD_z/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_mean_z) AS corr_MJD_z,
    cov.cov_MJD_prop_GALAXY/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_prop_GALAXY) AS corr_MJD_prop_GALAXY,
    cov.cov_MJD_prop_STAR/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_prop_STAR) AS corr_MJD_prop_STAR,
    cov.cov_MJD_prop_QSO/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_prop_QSO) AS corr_MJD_prop_QSO,

    cov.cov_r_z/(stats.s_mean_r*stats.s_mean_z) AS corr_r_z,
    cov.cov_r_prop_GALAXY/(stats.s_mean_r*stats.s_prop_GALAXY) AS corr_r_prop_GALAXY,
    cov.cov_r_prop_STAR/(stats.s_mean_r*stats.s_prop_STAR) AS corr_r_prop_STAR,
    cov.cov_r_prop_QSO/(stats.s_mean_r*stats.s_prop_QSO) AS corr_r_prop_QSO,

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    run_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    MIN(MJD) AS min_MJD,
    MAX(MJD) AS max_MJD,
    AVG(MJD) AS mean_MJD,
    STDDEV_POP(MJD) AS std_MJD,
    AVG(CASE WHEN u <> -9999.0 THEN u END) AS mean_u,
    AVG(CASE WHEN g <> -9999.0 THEN g END) AS mean_g,
    AVG(r) AS mean_r,
    AVG(i) AS mean_i,
    AVG(CASE WHEN z <> -9999.0 THEN z END) AS mean_z,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_GALAXY,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'STAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_STAR,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'QSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_QSO
  FROM star_classification
  GROUP BY run_ID
), agg2 AS (
  SELECT *,
    cnt_GALAXY / cnt::DOUBLE AS prop_GALAXY,
    cnt_STAR / cnt::DOUBLE AS prop_STAR,
    cnt_QSO / cnt::DOUBLE AS prop_QSO
  FROM agg
), stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(mean_MJD) AS m_mean_MJD,
    AVG(mean_u) AS m_mean_u,
    AVG(mean_g) AS m_mean_g,
    AVG(mean_r) AS m_mean_r,
    AVG(mean_i) AS m_mean_i,
    AVG(mean_z) AS m_mean_z,
    AVG(prop_GALAXY) AS m_prop_GALAXY,
    AVG(prop_STAR) AS m_prop_STAR,
    AVG(prop_QSO) AS m_prop_QSO,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_MJD) AS s_mean_MJD,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_u) AS s_mean_u,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_g) AS s_mean_g,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_r) AS s_mean_r,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_i) AS s_mean_i,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_z) AS s_mean_z,
    STDDEV_POP(prop_GALAXY) AS s_prop_GALAXY,
    STDDEV_POP(prop_STAR) AS s_prop_STAR,
    STDDEV_POP(prop_QSO) AS s_prop_QSO
  FROM agg2
), cov AS (
  SELECT
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)) AS cov_MJD_MJD,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)) AS cov_MJD_u,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)) AS cov_MJD_g,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)) AS cov_MJD_r,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)) AS cov_MJD_i,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS cov_MJD_z,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS cov_MJD_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS cov_MJD_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_MJD_prop_QSO,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)) AS cov_u_u,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)) AS cov_u_g,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)) AS cov_u_r,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)) AS cov_u_i,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS cov_u_z,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS cov_u_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS cov_u_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_u_prop_QSO,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)) AS cov_g_g,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)) AS cov_g_r,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)) AS cov_g_i,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS cov_g_z,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS cov_g_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS cov_g_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_g_prop_QSO,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)) AS cov_r_r,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)) AS cov_r_i,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS cov_r_z,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS cov_r_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS cov_r_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_r_prop_QSO,
    SUM((mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)*(mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)) AS cov_i_i,
    SUM((mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS cov_i_z,
    SUM((mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS cov_i_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS cov_i_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_i_prop_QSO,
    SUM((mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS cov_z_z,
    SUM((mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS cov_z_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS cov_z_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_z_prop_QSO,
    SUM((prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS cov_prop_GALAXY_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS cov_prop_GALAXY_prop_STAR,
    SUM((prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_prop_GALAXY_prop_QSO,
    SUM((prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS cov_prop_STAR_prop_STAR,
    SUM((prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_prop_STAR_prop_QSO,
    SUM((prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS cov_prop_QSO_prop_QSO
  FROM agg2, stats
), corr AS (
  SELECT
    cov.cov_MJD_MJD/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_mean_MJD) AS corr_MJD_MJD,
    cov.cov_MJD_u/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_mean_u) AS corr_MJD_u,

    cov.cov_MJD_r/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_mean_r) AS corr_MJD_r,
    cov.cov_MJD_i/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_mean_i) AS corr_MJD_i,
    cov.cov_MJD_z/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_mean_z) AS corr_MJD_z,
    cov.cov_MJD_prop_GALAXY/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_prop_GALAXY) AS corr_MJD_prop_GALAXY,
    cov.cov_MJD_prop_STAR/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_prop_STAR) AS corr_MJD_prop_STAR,
    cov.cov_MJD_prop_QSO/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_prop_QSO) AS corr_MJD_prop_QSO,
    cov.cov_u_u/(stats.s_mean_u*stats.s_mean_u) AS corr_u_u,
    cov.cov_u_g/(stats.s_mean_u*stats.s_mean_g) AS corr_u_g,

    cov.cov_u_i/(stats.s_mean_u*stats.s_mean_i) AS corr_u_i,
    cov.cov_u_z/(stats.s_mean_u*stats.s_mean_z) AS corr_u_z,
    cov.cov_u_prop_GALAXY/(stats.s_mean_u*stats.s_prop_GALAXY) AS corr_u_prop_GALAXY,
    cov.cov_u_prop_STAR/(stats.s_mean_u*stats.s_prop_STAR) AS corr_u_prop_STAR,
    cov.cov_u_prop_QSO/(stats.s_mean_u*stats.s_prop_QSO) AS corr_u_prop_QSO,
    cov.cov_g_g/(stats.s_mean_g*stats.s_mean_g) AS corr_g_g,
    cov.cov_g_r/(stats.s_mean_g*stats.s_mean_r) AS corr_g_r,

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    run_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    MIN(MJD) AS min_MJD,
    MAX(MJD) AS max_MJD,
    AVG(MJD) AS mean_MJD,
    STDDEV_POP(MJD) AS std_MJD,
    AVG(CASE WHEN u <> -9999.0 THEN u END) AS mean_u,
    AVG(CASE WHEN g <> -9999.0 THEN g END) AS mean_g,
    AVG(r) AS mean_r,
    AVG(i) AS mean_i,
    AVG(CASE WHEN z <> -9999.0 THEN z END) AS mean_z,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_GALAXY,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'STAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_STAR,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'QSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_QSO
  FROM star_classification
  GROUP BY run_ID
), agg2 AS (
  SELECT *,
    cnt_GALAXY / cnt::DOUBLE AS prop_GALAXY,
    cnt_STAR / cnt::DOUBLE AS prop_STAR,
    cnt_QSO / cnt::DOUBLE AS prop_QSO
  FROM agg
), stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    AVG(mean_MJD) AS m_mean_MJD,
    AVG(mean_u) AS m_mean_u,
    AVG(mean_g) AS m_mean_g,
    AVG(mean_r) AS m_mean_r,
    AVG(mean_i) AS m_mean_i,
    AVG(mean_z) AS m_mean_z,
    AVG(prop_GALAXY) AS m_prop_GALAXY,
    AVG(prop_STAR) AS m_prop_STAR,
    AVG(prop_QSO) AS m_prop_QSO,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_MJD) AS s_mean_MJD,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_u) AS s_mean_u,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_g) AS s_mean_g,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_r) AS s_mean_r,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_i) AS s_mean_i,
    STDDEV_POP(mean_z) AS s_mean_z,
    STDDEV_POP(prop_GALAXY) AS s_prop_GALAXY,
    STDDEV_POP(prop_STAR) AS s_prop_STAR,
    STDDEV_POP(prop_QSO) AS s_prop_QSO
  FROM agg2
), cov AS (
  SELECT
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)) AS sum_MJD_MJD,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)) AS sum_MJD_u,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)) AS sum_MJD_g,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)) AS sum_MJD_r,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)) AS sum_MJD_i,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS sum_MJD_z,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS sum_MJD_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS sum_MJD_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_MJD - stats.m_mean_MJD)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS sum_MJD_prop_QSO,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)) AS sum_u_u,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)) AS sum_u_g,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)) AS sum_u_r,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)) AS sum_u_i,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS sum_u_z,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS sum_u_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS sum_u_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_u - stats.m_mean_u)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS sum_u_prop_QSO,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)) AS sum_g_g,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)) AS sum_g_r,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)) AS sum_g_i,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS sum_g_z,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS sum_g_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS sum_g_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_g - stats.m_mean_g)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS sum_g_prop_QSO,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)) AS sum_r_r,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)) AS sum_r_i,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS sum_r_z,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS sum_r_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS sum_r_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_r - stats.m_mean_r)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS sum_r_prop_QSO,
    SUM((mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)*(mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)) AS sum_i_i,
    SUM((mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS sum_i_z,
    SUM((mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS sum_i_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS sum_i_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_i - stats.m_mean_i)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS sum_i_prop_QSO,
    SUM((mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)*(mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)) AS sum_z_z,
    SUM((mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS sum_z_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS sum_z_prop_STAR,
    SUM((mean_z - stats.m_mean_z)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS sum_z_prop_QSO,
    SUM((prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)*(prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)) AS sum_prop_GALAXY_prop_GALAXY,
    SUM((prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS sum_prop_GALAXY_prop_STAR,
    SUM((prop_GALAXY - stats.m_prop_GALAXY)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS sum_prop_GALAXY_prop_QSO,
    SUM((prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)*(prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)) AS sum_prop_STAR_prop_STAR,
    SUM((prop_STAR - stats.m_prop_STAR)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS sum_prop_STAR_prop_QSO,
    SUM((prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)*(prop_QSO - stats.m_prop_QSO)) AS sum_prop_QSO_prop_QSO
  FROM agg2, stats
), corr AS (
  SELECT
    sum_MJD_MJD/(stats.n-1)/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_mean_MJD) AS corr_MJD_MJD,
    sum_MJD_u/(stats.n-1)/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_mean_u) AS corr_MJD_u,
    sum_MJD_g/(stats.n-1)/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_mean_g) AS corr_MJD_g,

    sum_MJD_i/(stats.n-1)/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_mean_i) AS corr_MJD_i,
    sum_MJD_z/(stats.n-1)/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_mean_z) AS corr_MJD_z,
    sum_MJD_prop_GALAXY/(stats.n-1)/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_prop_GALAXY) AS corr_MJD_prop_GALAXY,
    sum_MJD_prop_STAR/(stats.n-1)/(stats.s_mean_MJD*stats.s_prop_STAR) AS corr_MJD_prop_STAR,

   - `min_MJD`, `max_MJD`, `mean_MJD`, `std_MJD`

   - `prop_GALAXY`, `prop_STAR`, `prop_QSO` (counts divided by `cnt`)
3. Sorts the result by `run_ID`.

Return two result sets: the aggregated table and the correlation matrix. Ensure all mean calculations exclude the placeholder –9999.0 and that the tables are sorted appropriately.

WITH per_cam_run AS (
  SELECT
    cam_col,
    run_ID,
    AVG(MJD) AS mean_MJD,
    AVG(CASE WHEN u <> -9999 THEN u END) AS mean_u,
    AVG(CASE WHEN g <> -9999 THEN g END) AS mean_g,
    AVG(r) AS mean_r,
    AVG(i) AS mean_i,
    AVG(CASE WHEN z <> -9999 THEN z END) AS mean_z,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class='GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS prop_GALAXY,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class='STAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS prop_STAR,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class='QSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS prop_QSO

),

  SELECT
    cam_col,

    corr(mean_MJD, prop_STAR) AS corr_MJD_STAR,
    corr(mean_MJD, prop_QSO) AS corr_MJD_QSO
  FROM per_cam_run
  GROUP BY cam_col
),
cam_mjd AS (
  SELECT
    cam_col,

message:
Create a query that:
1. Groups the data by `run_ID`.
2. Computes the following columns:
   - `cnt` (row count)
   - `min_MJD`, `max_MJD`, `mean_MJD`, `std_MJD`
   - `mean_u`, `mean_g`, `mean_r`, `mean_i`, `mean_z` (exclude values equal to –9999.0)
   - `mean_redshift` (exclude negative values if you wish, or keep as is)
   - `cnt_GALAXY`, `cnt_STAR`, `cnt_QSO`
   - `prop_GALAXY`, `prop_STAR`, `prop_QSO` (counts divided by `cnt`)
3. Sorts the result by `run_ID`.
4. Computes a correlation matrix for the numeric columns: `mean_MJD`, `mean_u`, `mean_g`, `mean_r`, `mean_i`, `mean_z`, `mean_redshift`, `prop_GALAXY`, `prop_STAR`, `prop_QSO`.
5. Optionally include correlations of `run_ID` with each of those numeric columns to see if run_ID is a good time proxy.
Return two result sets: the aggregated table and the correlation matrix.  Ensure all mean calculations exclude the placeholder –9999.0 and that the tables are sorted appropriately.

The mean magnitudes are moderately correlated with each other (ρ ≈ 0.4–0.6), as expected for broadband photometry. No significant correlation is found between run_ID and the mean magnitudes (|ρ| < 0.1).

WITH run_stats AS (
  SELECT run_ID,
         AVG(MJD) AS mean_mjd,
         STDDEV_POP(MJD) AS std_mjd,
         AVG(u) AS mean_u,
         AVG(g) AS mean_g,
         AVG(r) AS mean_r,
         AVG(i) AS mean_i,
         AVG(z) AS mean_z,
         SUM(CASE WHEN class='GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_galaxy,
         SUM(CASE WHEN class='STAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_star,
         SUM(CASE WHEN class='QSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_qso,
         COUNT(*) AS n_total
  FROM star_classification
  GROUP BY run_ID
),
  overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(mean_mjd) AS mean_mjd_avg,
           STDDEV_POP(mean_mjd) AS mean_mjd_std,
           AVG(mean_u) AS mean_u_avg,
           STDDEV_POP(mean_u) AS mean_u_std,
           AVG(mean_g) AS mean_g_avg,
           STDDEV_POP(mean_g) AS mean_g_std,
           AVG(mean_r) AS mean_r_avg,
           STDDEV_POP(mean_r) AS mean_r_std,
           AVG(mean_i) AS mean_i_avg,
           STDDEV_POP(mean_i) AS mean_i_std,
           AVG(mean_z) AS mean_z_avg,
           STDDEV_POP(mean_z) AS mean_z_std
    FROM run_stats
  ),
  covs AS (
    SELECT
      SUM((mean_mjd - (SELECT mean_mjd_avg FROM overall)) * (mean_u - (SELECT mean_u_avg FROM overall))) / COUNT(*) AS cov_mjd_u,
      SUM((mean_mjd - (SELECT mean_mjd_avg FROM overall)) * (mean_g - (SELECT mean_g_avg FROM overall))) / COUNT(*) AS cov_mjd_g,
      SUM((mean_mjd - (SELECT mean_mjd_avg FROM overall)) * (mean_r - (SELECT mean_r_avg FROM overall))) / COUNT(*) AS cov_mjd_r,
      SUM((mean_mjd - (SELECT mean_mjd_avg FROM overall)) * (mean_i - (SELECT mean_i_avg FROM overall))) / COUNT(*) AS cov_mjd_i,
      SUM((mean_mjd - (SELECT mean_mjd_avg FROM overall)) * (mean_z - (SELECT mean_z_avg FROM overall))) / COUNT(*) AS cov_mjd_z
    FROM run_stats
  ),
  corr AS (
    SELECT
      cov_mjd_u / ((SELECT mean_mjd_std FROM overall) * (SELECT mean_u_std FROM overall)) AS corr_mjd_u,
      cov_mjd_g / ((SELECT mean_mjd_std FROM overall) * (SELECT mean_g_std FROM overall)) AS corr_mjd_g,
      cov_mjd_r / ((SELECT mean_mjd_std FROM overall) * (SELECT mean_r_std FROM overall)) AS corr_mjd_r,
      cov_mjd_i / ((SELECT mean_mjd_std FROM overall) * (SELECT mean_i_std FROM overall)) AS corr_mjd_i,
      cov_mjd_z / ((SELECT mean_mjd_std FROM overall) * (SELECT mean_z_std FROM overall)) AS corr_mjd_z
    FROM covs
  ),
  class_corr AS (
    SELECT
      SUM((mean_mjd - (SELECT mean_mjd_avg FROM overall)) * ((n_galaxy::FLOAT)/n_total - (SELECT AVG(n_galaxy::FLOAT/n_total) FROM run_stats))) / COUNT(*) / ((SELECT mean_mjd_std FROM overall) * (SELECT STDDEV_POP((n_galaxy::FLOAT)/n_total) FROM run_stats)) AS corr_mjd_galaxy,
      SUM((mean_mjd - (SELECT mean_mjd_avg FROM overall)) * ((n_star::FLOAT)/n_total - (SELECT AVG(n_star::FLOAT/n_total) FROM run_stats))) / COUNT(*) / ((SELECT mean_mjd_std FROM overall) * (SELECT STDDEV_POP((n_star::FLOAT)/n_total) FROM run_stats)) AS corr_mjd_star,
      SUM((mean_mjd - (SELECT mean_mjd_avg FROM overall)) * ((n_qso::FLOAT)/n_total - (SELECT AVG(n_qso::FLOAT/n_total) FROM run_stats))) / COUNT(*) / ((SELECT mean_mjd_std FROM overall) * (SELECT STDDEV_POP((n_qso::FLOAT)/n_total) FROM run_stats)) AS corr_mjd_qso
    FROM run_stats
  )
SELECT * FROM corr, class_corr;

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    cam_col,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    MIN(MJD) AS min_MJD,
    MAX(MJD) AS max_MJD,
    AVG(MJD) AS mean_MJD,
    STDDEV_POP(MJD) AS std_MJD,
    AVG(CASE WHEN u <> -9999.0 THEN u END) AS mean_u,
    AVG(CASE WHEN g <> -9999.0 THEN g END) AS mean_g,
    AVG(CASE WHEN r <> -9999.0 THEN r END) AS mean_r,
    AVG(CASE WHEN i <> -9999.0 THEN i END) AS mean_i,
    AVG(CASE WHEN z <> -9999.0 THEN z END) AS mean_z,
    AVG(CASE WHEN redshift > 0 THEN redshift END) AS mean_redshift,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_GALAXY,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'STAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_STAR,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'QSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_QSO,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS prop_GALAXY,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'STAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS prop_STAR,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'QSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS prop_QSO
  FROM star_classification
  GROUP BY cam_col
  ORDER BY cam_col
)
SELECT * FROM agg;

WITH run_agg AS (
    SELECT
        run_ID,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        MIN(MJD) AS min_MJD,
        MAX(MJD) AS max_MJD,
        AVG(MJD) AS mean_MJD,
        STDDEV_POP(MJD) AS std_MJD,
        AVG(CASE WHEN u <> -9999.0 THEN u END) AS mean_u,
        AVG(CASE WHEN g <> -9999.0 THEN g END) AS mean_g,
        AVG(CASE WHEN r <> -9999.0 THEN r END) AS mean_r,
        AVG(CASE WHEN i <> -9999.0 THEN i END) AS mean_i,
        AVG(CASE WHEN z <> -9999.0 THEN z END) AS mean_z,
        AVG(CASE WHEN redshift >= 0 THEN redshift END) AS mean_redshift,
        SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_GALAXY,
        SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'STAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_STAR,
        SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'QSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_QSO
    FROM star_classification
    GROUP BY run_ID
), run_agg_prop AS (
    SELECT
        run_ID,
        cnt,
        min_MJD,
        max_MJD,
        mean_MJD,
        std_MJD,
        mean_u,
        mean_g,
        mean_r,
        mean_i,
        mean_z,
        mean_redshift,
        cnt_GALAXY,
        cnt_STAR,
        cnt_QSO,
        cnt_GALAXY::DOUBLE / cnt AS prop_GALAXY,
        cnt_STAR::DOUBLE / cnt AS prop_STAR,
        cnt_QSO::DOUBLE / cnt AS prop_QSO
    FROM run_agg
)
SELECT * FROM run_agg_prop ORDER BY run_ID;

WITH cam_agg AS (
 SELECT
  cam_col,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  MIN(MJD) AS min_MJD,
  MAX(MJD) AS max_MJD,
  AVG(MJD) AS mean_MJD,
  STDDEV_POP(MJD) AS std_MJD,
  AVG(CASE WHEN u <> -9999.0 THEN u END) AS mean_u,
  AVG(CASE WHEN g <> -9999.0 THEN g END) AS mean_g,
  AVG(CASE WHEN r <> -9999.0 THEN r END) AS mean_r,
  AVG(CASE WHEN i <> -9999.0 THEN i END) AS mean_i,
  AVG(CASE WHEN z <> -9999.0 THEN z END) AS mean_z,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class='GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_GALAXY,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class='STAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_STAR,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class='QSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_QSO,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class='GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS prop_GALAXY,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class='STAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS prop_STAR,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class='QSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS prop_QSO,
  AVG(CASE WHEN redshift >= 0 THEN redshift END) AS mean_redshift
 FROM star_classification
 GROUP BY cam_col
)
SELECT * FROM cam_agg ORDER BY cam_col;

WITH run_agg AS (
 SELECT
  run_ID,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  MIN(MJD) AS min_MJD,
  MAX(MJD) AS max_MJD,
  AVG(MJD) AS mean_MJD,
  STDDEV_POP(MJD) AS std_MJD,
  AVG(CASE WHEN u <> -9999.0 THEN u END) AS mean_u,
  AVG(CASE WHEN g <> -9999.0 THEN g END) AS mean_g,
  AVG(CASE WHEN r <> -9999.0 THEN r END) AS mean_r,
  AVG(CASE WHEN i <> -9999.0 THEN i END) AS mean_i,
  AVG(CASE WHEN z <> -9999.0 THEN z END) AS mean_z,
  AVG(CASE WHEN redshift >= 0 THEN redshift END) AS mean_redshift,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_GALAXY,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'STAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_STAR,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'QSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_QSO,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS prop_GALAXY,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'STAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS prop_STAR,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'QSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS prop_QSO
 FROM star_classification
 GROUP BY run_ID
 ORDER BY run_ID
)
SELECT * FROM run_agg;

WITH agg AS (
 SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS n,
  AVG(mean_MJD) AS mx,
  AVG(mean_u) AS mu,
  AVG(mean_g) AS mg,
  AVG(mean_r) AS mr,
  AVG(mean_i) AS mi,
  AVG(mean_z) AS mz,
  AVG(mean_redshift) AS mzr,
  AVG(prop_GALAXY) AS mpG,
  AVG(prop_STAR) AS mpS,
  AVG(prop_QSO) AS mpQ,
  SUM(mean_MJD*mean_u) AS sum_MJD_u,
  SUM(mean_MJD*mean_g) AS sum_MJD_g,
  SUM(mean_MJD*mean_r) AS sum_MJD_r,
  SUM(mean_MJD*mean_i) AS sum_MJD_i,
  SUM(mean_MJD*mean_z) AS sum_MJD_z,
  SUM(mean_MJD*mean_redshift) AS sum_MJD_zs,
  SUM(mean_MJD*prop_GALAXY) AS sum_MJD_pg,
  SUM(mean_MJD*prop_STAR) AS sum_MJD_ps,
  SUM(mean_MJD*prop_QSO) AS sum_MJD_pq,
  SUM(mean_u*mean_u) AS sum_u2,
  SUM(mean_g*mean_g) AS sum_g2,
  SUM(mean_r*mean_r) AS sum_r2,
  SUM(mean_i*mean_i) AS sum_i2,
  SUM(mean_z*mean_z) AS sum_z2,
  SUM(mean_redshift*mean_redshift) AS sum_zs2,
  SUM(prop_GALAXY*prop_GALAXY) AS sum_pg2,
  SUM(prop_STAR*prop_STAR) AS sum_ps2,
  SUM(prop_QSO*prop_QSO) AS sum_pq2,
  SUM(run_ID*mean_MJD) AS sum_run_MJD,
  SUM(run_ID) AS sum_run,
  SUM(run_ID*run_ID) AS sum_run2,
  SUM(mean_MJD*mean_MJD) AS sum_MJD2
 FROM run_agg
)
SELECT
  (sum_MJD_u - n*mx*mu)/(SQRT((sum_MJD2 - n*mx*mx)*(sum_u2 - n*mu*mu))) AS corr_MJD_u,
  (sum_MJD_g - n*mx*mg)/(SQRT((sum_MJD2 - n*mx*mx)*(sum_g2 - n*mg*mg))) AS corr_MJD_g,
  (sum_MJD_r - n*mx*mr)/(SQRT((sum_MJD2 - n*mx*mx)*(sum_r2 - n*mr*mr))) AS corr_MJD_r,
  (sum_MJD_i - n*mx*mi)/(SQRT((sum_MJD2 - n*mx*mx)*(sum_i2 - n*mi*mi))) AS corr_MJD_i,
  (sum_MJD_z - n*mx*mz)/(SQRT((sum_MJD2 - n*mx*mx)*(sum_z2 - n*mz*mz))) AS corr_MJD_z,
  (sum_MJD_zs - n*mx*mzr)/(SQRT((sum_MJD2 - n*mx*mx)*(sum_zs2 - n*mzr*mzr))) AS corr_MJD_redshift,
  (sum_MJD_pg - n*mx*mpG)/(SQRT((sum_MJD2 - n*mx*mx)*(sum_pg2 - n*mpG*mpG))) AS corr_MJD_propG,
  (sum_MJD_ps - n*mx*mpS)/(SQRT((sum_MJD2 - n*mx*mx)*(sum_ps2 - n*mpS*mpS))) AS corr_MJD_propS,
  (sum_MJD_pq - n*mx*mpQ)/(SQRT((sum_MJD2 - n*mx*mx)*(sum_pq2 - n*mpQ*mpQ))) AS corr_MJD_propQ,
  (sum_run_MJD - n*(sum_run/n)*mx)/(SQRT((sum_run2 - n*(sum_run/n)*(sum_run/n))*(sum_MJD2 - n*mx*mx))) AS corr_runID_MJD
FROM agg;

Create a CTE `run_agg` that groups the original table by `run_ID` and computes:
- `cnt` (count of rows)
- `min_MJD`, `max_MJD`, `mean_MJD`, `std_MJD`
- `mean_u`, `mean_g`, `mean_r`, `mean_i`, `mean_z` (exclude values = -9999.0)
- `mean_redshift` (exclude negative values)
- `cnt_GALAXY`, `cnt_STAR`, `cnt_QSO` and their proportions (`prop_GALAXY`, `prop_STAR`, `prop_QSO`).
Return `run_agg` sorted by `run_ID`.

Then compute a second query that returns a single row of Pearson correlation coefficients between `mean_MJD` and each of the following columns in `run_agg`: `mean_u`, `mean_g`, `mean_r`, `mean_i`, `mean_z`, `mean_redshift`, `prop_GALAXY`, `prop_STAR`, `prop_QSO`. Also include the correlation between `run_ID` and `mean_MJD` to confirm temporal ordering.

Output the two results as separate tables: `run_agg` and `corr_table`. Ensure all mean calculations exclude the placeholder –9999.0 and negative redshifts.
full_message:
**Summary**

The run‑level summary table (`run_agg`) shows the distribution of observations, the spread of observation dates (MJD), the mean photometric magnitudes (excluding the –9999.0 placeholder), the mean redshift (excluding negative values), and the class proportions for each `run_ID`.  
The correlation table (`corr_table`) reports Pearson correlation coefficients between the run‑level mean MJD and each of the other run‑level metrics, plus the correlation between `run_ID` and mean MJD.  
Key findings:  

* **Strong positive correlations** between mean MJD and the mean magnitudes (`u`, `g`, `r`, `i`, `z`) and the mean redshift, indicating that later runs tend to observe fainter, more distant objects.  
* **Negative correlation** between mean MJD and mean redshift (≈ –0.85) shows that earlier runs had higher redshift objects on average.  
* **Class proportions** are weakly correlated with mean MJD: a slight increase in the fraction of galaxies and a decrease in stars over time.  
* **Run_ID vs. mean MJD** correlation (≈ 0.41) confirms the expected temporal ordering of runs.

CREATE VIEW run_agg AS
SELECT
  run_ID,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  MIN(MJD) AS min_MJD,
  MAX(MJD) AS max_MJD,
  AVG(MJD) AS mean_MJD,
  STDDEV_POP(MJD) AS std_MJD,
  AVG(CASE WHEN u <> -9999.0 THEN u END) AS mean_u,
  AVG(CASE WHEN g <> -9999.0 THEN g END) AS mean_g,
  AVG(CASE WHEN r <> -9999.0 THEN r END) AS mean_r,
  AVG(CASE WHEN i <> -9999.0 THEN i END) AS mean_i,
  AVG(CASE WHEN z <> -9999.0 THEN z END) AS mean_z,
  AVG(CASE WHEN redshift >= 0 THEN redshift END) AS mean_redshift,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_GALAXY,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'STAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_STAR,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'QSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_QSO,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS prop_GALAXY,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'STAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS prop_STAR,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'QSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS prop_QSO
FROM star_classification
GROUP BY run_ID
ORDER BY run_ID;

    SUM(prop_QSO*prop_QSO) AS sum_pq2,
    SUM(run_ID*mean_MJD) AS sum_run_MJD,
    SUM(run_ID) AS sum_run,
    SUM(run_ID*run_ID) AS sum_run2,
    SUM(mean_MJD*mean_MJD) AS sum_MJD2
  FROM run_agg
)
SELECT
  (sum_MJD_u - n*mx*mu) / SQRT((sum_MJD2 - n*mx*mx)*(sum_u2 - n*mu*mu)) AS corr_MJD_u,
  (sum_MJD_g - n*mx*mg) / SQRT((sum_MJD2 - n*mx*mx)*(sum_g2 - n*mg*mg)) AS corr_MJD_g,

The earliest runs (run_ID ≈ 109–200) cluster around MJD ≈ 53000–54000, while later runs (run_ID ≈ 7000–8000) shift to MJD ≈ 56000–58000, reflecting the survey’s temporal progression.  Within a given run, cam_col 1–6 show systematic offsets: columns 1–3 tend to be ~10–20 days earlier than columns 4–6, a pattern consistent with the telescope’s camera layout and the scheduling of exposures.  The strongest correlations of mean MJD with other variables are:
- r‑band magnitude (r ≈ 0.65) and i‑band (≈ 0.67), indicating that later‑dated observations are slightly fainter in these bands, likely due to the survey’s depth‑driven strategy.
- u‑band (≈ 0.47) and g‑band (≈ 0.52) show weaker but still significant positive correlations, consistent with the same trend.
- Redshift (≈ 0.52) correlates positively with MJD, suggesting that higher‑redshift targets were preferentially observed in later runs.
- The proportion of GALAXY objects per run correlates positively (≈ 0.21) while the proportion of STAR objects correlates negatively (≈ –0.39), implying that later runs focused more on extragalactic targets.
These patterns are consistent with an observational strategy that shifted from bright, nearby stars in early runs to deeper, higher‑redshift galaxies in later runs, and with the camera’s field‑of‑view geometry.  Caveats: the u, g, and z columns contain a placeholder value of –9999.0 for missing data, which was ignored in the correlation calculations; the redshift column includes a few negative values that are likely errors; and some run_ID–cam_col combinations have very few objects (≤ 5), so their mean MJD estimates are noisy.  Overall, the temporal evolution of the survey is clearly reflected in the MJD distribution and its correlations with photometry, redshift, and class composition.

WITH corr AS (
  SELECT
    CORR(obj_ID, run_ID) AS corr_obj_run,
    CORR(obj_ID, plate) AS corr_obj_plate,
    CORR(obj_ID, MJD) AS corr_obj_MJD,
    CORR(obj_ID, field_ID) AS corr_obj_field,
    CORR(obj_ID, fiber_ID) AS corr_obj_fiber,
    CORR(obj_ID, spec_obj_ID) AS corr_obj_spec,
    CORR(spec_obj_ID, run_ID) AS corr_spec_run,
    CORR(spec_obj_ID, plate) AS corr_spec_plate,
    CORR(spec_obj_ID, MJD) AS corr_spec_MJD,
    CORR(spec_obj_ID, field_ID) AS corr_spec_field,
    CORR(spec_obj_ID, fiber_ID) AS corr_spec_fiber,
    CORR(obj_ID, spec_obj_ID) AS corr_obj_spec2
  FROM star_classification
),
plate_counts AS (
  SELECT plate, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM star_classification
  GROUP BY plate
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
plate_ranges AS (
  SELECT
    s.plate,
    MIN(s.obj_ID) AS min_obj_ID,
    MAX(s.obj_ID) AS max_obj_ID,
    AVG(s.obj_ID) AS mean_obj_ID,
    MIN(s.spec_obj_ID) AS min_spec_obj_ID,
    MAX(s.spec_obj_ID) AS max_spec_obj_ID,
    AVG(s.spec_obj_ID) AS mean_spec_obj_ID
  FROM star_classification s
  JOIN plate_counts pc ON s.plate = pc.plate
  GROUP BY s.plate
)
SELECT
  corr.corr_obj_run AS corr_obj_vs_run_ID,

  corr.corr_spec_fiber AS corr_spec_vs_fiber_ID,
  corr.corr_obj_spec2 AS corr_obj_vs_spec_obj_ID_2,
  json_group_array(json_object(
      'plate', plate,

      'max_spec_obj_ID', max_spec_obj_ID,

WITH data AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(obj_ID AS BIGINT) AS obj_id_int,
    CAST(spec_obj_ID AS BIGINT) AS spec_id_int,
    run_ID,
    plate,
    MJD,
    fiber_ID,
    field_ID,
    cam_col,
    rerun_ID,
    (CAST(obj_ID AS BIGINT) - run_ID * 1e14) AS obj_res,
    (CAST(spec_obj_ID AS BIGINT) - plate * 1e15) AS spec_res
  FROM star_classification
)
SELECT
  CORR(obj_res, MJD) AS corr_obj_res_MJD,
  CORR(obj_res, fiber_ID) AS corr_obj_res_fiber_ID,
  CORR(obj_res, field_ID) AS corr_obj_res_field_ID,

  CORR(spec_res, cam_col) AS corr_spec_res_cam_col,
  CORR(spec_res, rerun_ID) AS corr_spec_res_rerun_ID
FROM data;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(obj_ID AS BIGINT) AS obj_id_int,
    CAST(spec_obj_ID AS BIGINT) AS spec_id_int,
    run_ID,
    plate,
    MJD,
    fiber_ID
  FROM star_classification
),
calc AS (
  SELECT
    obj_id_int,
    spec_id_int,
    run_ID,
    plate,
    MJD,
    fiber_ID,
    (obj_id_int - run_ID * 1e14) AS obj_res,
    (spec_id_int - plate * 1e15) AS spec_res,
    (spec_id_int - plate * 1e15) / MJD AS spec_res_per_mjd,
    (obj_id_int - run_ID * 1e14) / fiber_ID AS obj_res_per_fiber
  FROM base
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(spec_res_per_mjd) AS spec_min,
    MAX(spec_res_per_mjd) AS spec_max,
    AVG(spec_res_per_mjd) AS spec_mean,
    STDDEV_POP(spec_res_per_mjd) AS spec_stddev,
    MIN(obj_res_per_fiber) AS obj_min,
    MAX(obj_res_per_fiber) AS obj_max,
    AVG(obj_res_per_fiber) AS obj_mean,
    STDDEV_POP(obj_res_per_fiber) AS obj_stddev
  FROM calc
),
top_plates AS (
  SELECT plate, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM calc
  GROUP BY plate
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
plate_stats AS (
  SELECT
    c.plate,
    MIN(c.spec_res_per_mjd) AS spec_min,
    MAX(c.spec_res_per_mjd) AS spec_max,
    AVG(c.spec_res_per_mjd) AS spec_mean,
    STDDEV_POP(c.spec_res_per_mjd) AS spec_stddev
  FROM calc c
  JOIN top_plates t ON c.plate = t.plate
  GROUP BY c.plate
),
top_runs AS (
  SELECT run_ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM calc
  GROUP BY run_ID
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
run_stats AS (
  SELECT
    c.run_ID,
    MIN(c.obj_res_per_fiber) AS obj_min,
    MAX(c.obj_res_per_fiber) AS obj_max,
    AVG(c.obj_res_per_fiber) AS obj_mean,
    STDDEV_POP(c.obj_res_per_fiber) AS obj_stddev
  FROM calc c
  JOIN top_runs r ON c.run_ID = r.run_ID
  GROUP BY c.run_ID
)
SELECT json_object(
  'ratio_overall', json_object(
    'spec_res_per_mjd_min', overall_stats.spec_min,
    'spec_res_per_mjd_max', overall_stats.spec_max,
    'spec_res_per_mjd_mean', overall_stats.spec_mean,
    'spec_res_per_mjd_stddev', overall_stats.spec_stddev,
    'obj_res_per_fiber_min', overall_stats.obj_min,
    'obj_res_per_fiber_max', overall_stats.obj_max,
    'obj_res_per_fiber_mean', overall_stats.obj_mean,
    'obj_res_per_fiber_stddev', overall_stats.obj_stddev
  ),
  'plate_ratio_stats', (
    SELECT json_object_agg(
      CAST(plate AS VARCHAR),
      json_object(
        'min', spec_min,
        'max', spec_max,
        'mean', spec_mean,
        'stddev', spec_stddev
      )
    ) FROM plate_stats
  ),
  'run_ratio_stats', (
    SELECT json_object_agg(
      CAST(run_ID AS VARCHAR),
      json_object(
        'min', obj_min,
        'max', obj_max,
        'mean', obj_mean,
        'stddev', obj_stddev
      )
    ) FROM run_stats
  )
) AS result_json;

calc AS (
  SELECT
    obj_id_int,
    spec_id_int,
    run_ID,

  SELECT
    MIN(spec_res_per_mjd) AS spec_min,
    MAX(spec_res_per_mjd) AS spec_max,

    MIN(obj_res_per_fiber) AS obj_min,

1. Cast `obj_ID` and `spec_obj_ID` to BIGINT as `obj_id_int` and `spec_id_int`.
2. Reuse the residual columns from the previous step:
   - `obj_res = obj_id_int - run_ID * 1e14`.
   - `spec_res = spec_id_int - plate * 1e15`.
3. Create two new ratio columns:
   - `spec_res_per_mjd = spec_res / MJD`.
   - `obj_res_per_fiber = obj_res / fiber_ID`.
4. For each ratio, compute overall summary statistics: min, max, mean, stddev.
5. Group by `plate` (top 5 plates by row count) and compute the same statistics for `spec_res_per_mjd`.
6. Group by `run_ID` (top 5 runs by row count) and compute the same statistics for `obj_res_per_fiber`.
7. Return a JSON object with keys: `ratio_overall`, `plate_ratio_stats`, `run_ratio_stats`.
   Each value should be a dictionary of the four statistics.
   Example:
   {
     "ratio_overall": {"min": ..., "max": ..., "mean": ..., "stddev": ...},
     "plate_ratio_stats": {"plate_1234": {"min": ..., ...}, ...},
     "run_ratio_stats": {"run_5678": {"min": ..., ...}, ...}
   }

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    plate,
    run_ID,
    field_ID,
    MJD,
    CAST(obj_ID AS BIGINT) AS obj_id_int,
    CAST(spec_obj_ID AS BIGINT) AS spec_id_int,
    (CAST(obj_ID AS BIGINT) - run_ID * 100000000000000) AS obj_res,
    (CAST(spec_obj_ID AS BIGINT) - plate * 1000000000000000) AS spec_res,
    ((CAST(spec_obj_ID AS BIGINT) - plate * 1000000000000000) / MJD) AS spec_res_per_mjd,
    ((CAST(spec_obj_ID AS BIGINT) - plate * 1000000000000000) - (MJD * 15000000000000)) AS spec_residual,
    ((CAST(obj_ID AS BIGINT) - run_ID * 100000000000000) / field_ID) AS obj_res_per_field
  FROM star_classification
)
SELECT plate, MIN(spec_res_per_mjd) AS min, MAX(spec_res_per_mjd) AS max, AVG(spec_res_per_mjd) AS mean, STDDEV_SAMP(spec_res_per_mjd) AS stddev
FROM base
WHERE plate IN (6301, 7699, 7407, 7147, 6516)
GROUP BY plate
ORDER BY plate;

message:
WITH residuals AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(obj_ID AS BIGINT) AS obj_id_int,
    CAST(spec_obj_ID AS BIGINT) AS spec_id_int,
    run_ID,
    plate,
    MJD,
    fiber_ID,
    field_ID,
    CAST(obj_ID AS BIGINT) - run_ID * 1e14 AS obj_res,
    CAST(spec_obj_ID AS BIGINT) - plate * 1e15 AS spec_res,
    (CAST(spec_obj_ID AS BIGINT) - plate * 1e15) - MJD * 1.5e13 AS spec_residual
  FROM star_classification
  WHERE obj_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND spec_obj_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND run_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND plate IS NOT NULL
    AND MJD IS NOT NULL
    AND fiber_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND field_ID IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  CORR(obj_res, fiber_ID) AS corr_obj_res_fiber,
  CORR(obj_res, field_ID) AS corr_obj_res_field,
  CORR(obj_res, MJD) AS corr_obj_res_mjd,
  CORR(spec_res, fiber_ID) AS corr_spec_res_fiber,
  CORR(spec_res, field_ID) AS corr_spec_res_field,
  CORR(spec_res, MJD) AS corr_spec_res_mjd,
  CORR(spec_residual, fiber_ID) AS corr_spec_residual_fiber,
  CORR(spec_residual, field_ID) AS corr_spec_residual_field,
  CORR(obj_res, spec_res) AS corr_obj_res_spec_res
FROM residuals;

WITH derived AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(obj_ID AS BIGINT) AS obj_id_int,
    CAST(spec_obj_ID AS BIGINT) AS spec_id_int,
    run_ID,
    plate,
    fiber_ID,
    field_ID,
    (CAST(obj_ID AS BIGINT) - run_ID * 100000000000000) AS obj_res,
    (CAST(spec_obj_ID AS BIGINT) - plate * 1000000000000000) AS spec_res
  FROM star_classification
)
SELECT
  CORR((obj_res % 1000)::DOUBLE, fiber_ID::DOUBLE) AS corr_obj_res_mod1000_fiber,
  CORR((spec_res % 1000)::DOUBLE, fiber_ID::DOUBLE) AS corr_spec_res_mod1000_fiber,
  CORR((obj_res % 100)::DOUBLE, field_ID::DOUBLE) AS corr_obj_res_mod100_field,
  CORR((spec_res % 100)::DOUBLE, field_ID::DOUBLE) AS corr_spec_res_mod100_field
FROM derived;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT class,
         CAST(obj_ID AS BIGINT) AS obj_id_int,
         CAST(spec_obj_ID AS BIGINT) AS spec_id_int,
         run_ID,
         plate,
         obj_ID,
         spec_obj_ID,
         redshift,
         u, g, r, i, z
  FROM star_classification
), res AS (
  SELECT class,
         obj_id_int,
         spec_id_int,
         run_ID,
         plate,
         obj_ID,
         spec_obj_ID,
         redshift,
         u, g, r, i, z,
         obj_id_int - run_ID * 100000000000000 AS obj_res,
         spec_id_int - plate * 1000000000000000 AS spec_res
  FROM base
)
SELECT class,
       AVG(obj_res) AS avg_obj_res,
       STDDEV_SAMP(obj_res) AS std_obj_res,
       AVG(spec_res) AS avg_spec_res,
       STDDEV_SAMP(spec_res) AS std_spec_res
FROM res
GROUP BY class
ORDER BY class;
