WITH derived AS (
 SELECT
  obj_ID,
  run_ID,
  MJD,
  field_ID,
  fiber_ID,
  spec_obj_ID,
  plate,
  FLOOR(obj_ID / 1e12) AS obj_run_part,
  obj_ID - FLOOR(obj_ID / 1e12) * 1e12 AS obj_residual,
  FLOOR((obj_ID - FLOOR(obj_ID / 1e12) * 1e12) / 1e8) AS obj_mjd_part,
  FLOOR(((obj_ID - FLOOR(obj_ID / 1e12) * 1e12) % 1e8) / 1e4) AS obj_field_part,
  (obj_ID - FLOOR(obj_ID / 1e12) * 1e12) % 1e4 AS obj_fiber_part,
  FLOOR(spec_obj_ID / 1e13) AS spec_plate_part,
  spec_obj_ID - FLOOR(spec_obj_ID / 1e13) * 1e13 AS spec_residual,
  FLOOR((spec_obj_ID - FLOOR(spec_obj_ID / 1e13) * 1e13) / 1e8) AS spec_mjd_part,
  (spec_obj_ID - FLOOR(spec_obj_ID / 1e13) * 1e13) % 1e8 AS spec_fiber_part
 FROM star_classification
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_obj_run,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE obj_run_part = run_ID) AS matches_obj_run,
  CORR(obj_run_part, run_ID) AS corr_obj_run,
  COUNT(*) AS total_obj_mjd,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE obj_mjd_part = MJD) AS matches_obj_mjd,
  CORR(obj_mjd_part, MJD) AS corr_obj_mjd,
  COUNT(*) AS total_obj_field,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE obj_field_part = field_ID) AS matches_obj_field,
  CORR(obj_field_part, field_ID) AS corr_obj_field,
  COUNT(*) AS total_obj_fiber,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE obj_fiber_part = fiber_ID) AS matches_obj_fiber,
  CORR(obj_fiber_part, fiber_ID) AS corr_obj_fiber,
  COUNT(*) AS total_spec_plate,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE spec_plate_part = plate) AS matches_spec_plate,
  CORR(spec_plate_part, plate) AS corr_spec_plate,
  COUNT(*) AS total_spec_mjd,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE spec_mjd_part = MJD) AS matches_spec_mjd,
  CORR(spec_mjd_part, MJD) AS corr_spec_mjd,
  COUNT(*) AS total_spec_fiber,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE spec_fiber_part = fiber_ID) AS matches_spec_fiber,
  CORR(spec_fiber_part, fiber_ID) AS corr_spec_fiber,
  AVG(obj_residual) AS obj_mean,
  STDDEV_SAMP(obj_residual) AS obj_stddev,
  MIN(obj_residual) AS obj_min,
  MAX(obj_residual) AS obj_max,
  AVG(spec_residual) AS spec_mean,
  STDDEV_SAMP(spec_residual) AS spec_stddev,
  MIN(spec_residual) AS spec_min,
  MAX(spec_residual) AS spec_max
FROM derived;

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM star_classification
  WHERE u <> -9999.0 AND g <> -9999.0 AND r <> -9999.0 AND i <> -9999.0 AND z <> -9999.0
)

  fiber_ID,
  plate,
  COUNT(*) AS total_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN class='GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gal_cnt,

  AVG(u) AS mean_u,

  AVG(r) AS mean_r,
  AVG(i) AS mean_i,
  AVG(z) AS mean_z,
  STDDEV_POP(u) AS std_u,
  STDDEV_POP(g) AS std_g,
  STDDEV_POP(r) AS std_r,
  STDDEV_POP(i) AS std_i,
  STDDEV_POP(z) AS std_z
FROM filtered
GROUP BY fiber_ID, plate
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

instruction:
Run the following two DuckDB queries.  Each query should compute overall reference statistics (after filtering out the placeholder value –9999 for magnitudes).  Then aggregate by plate (first query) and by fiber_ID (second query), compute class‑proportion z‑scores and mean‑magnitude z‑scores, and filter for any group where |z| > 2 or any missing‑fraction > 0.5.  Return the top 20 rows for each query, sorted by the largest absolute z‑score in the row.  Output plain tables with the columns shown below.

**Plate‑level query**
```sql
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_cnt,
    AVG(NULLIF(u, -9999)) AS mean_u, STDDEV(NULLIF(u, -9999)) AS std_u,
    AVG(NULLIF(g, -9999)) AS mean_g, STDDEV(NULLIF(g, -9999)) AS std_g,
    AVG(NULLIF(r, -9999)) AS mean_r, STDDEV(NULLIF(r, -9999)) AS std_r,
    AVG(NULLIF(i, -9999)) AS mean_i, STDDEV(NULLIF(i, -9999)) AS std_i,
    AVG(NULLIF(z, -9999)) AS mean_z, STDDEV(NULLIF(z, -9999)) AS std_z,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class='GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS prop_gal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class='STAR'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS prop_star,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class='QSO'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS prop_qso
  FROM star_classification
),
plate_agg AS (
  SELECT
    plate,
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class='GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_gal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class='STAR'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_star,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class='QSO'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_qso,
    AVG(NULLIF(u, -9999)) AS mean_u,
    AVG(NULLIF(g, -9999)) AS mean_g,
    AVG(NULLIF(r, -9999)) AS mean_r,
    AVG(NULLIF(i, -9999)) AS mean_i,
    AVG(NULLIF(z, -9999)) AS mean_z,
    SUM(CASE WHEN u = -9999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS pct_missing_u,
    SUM(CASE WHEN g = -9999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS pct_missing_g,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z = -9999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS pct_missing_z
  FROM star_classification
  GROUP BY plate
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
)
SELECT
  p.plate,
  p.n,
  p.n_gal, p.n_star, p.n_qso,
  p.n_gal::DOUBLE/p.n AS gal_pct,
  p.n_star::DOUBLE/p.n AS star_pct,
  p.n_qso::DOUBLE/p.n AS qso_pct,
  -- Class proportion z‑scores
  (p.n_gal::DOUBLE/p.n - o.prop_gal)/SQRT(o.prop_gal*(1-o.prop_gal)/p.n) AS z_gal_pct,
  (p.n_star::DOUBLE/p.n - o.prop_star)/SQRT(o.prop_star*(1-o.prop_star)/p.n) AS z_star_pct,
  (p.n_qso::DOUBLE/p.n - o.prop_qso)/SQRT(o.prop_qso*(1-o.prop_qso)/p.n) AS z_qso_pct,
  -- Mean magnitude z‑scores
  (p.mean_u - o.mean_u)/o.std_u AS z_mean_u,
  (p.mean_g - o.mean_g)/o.std_g AS z_mean_g,
  (p.mean_r - o.mean_r)/o.std_r AS z_mean_r,

instruction:
Run the following two DuckDB queries.  Each query should compute overall reference statistics (after filtering out the placeholder value –9999 for magnitudes).  Then aggregate by plate (first query) and by fiber_ID (second query), compute class‑proportion z‑scores and mean‑magnitude z‑scores, and filter for any group where |z| > 2 or any missing‑fraction > 0.5.  Return the top 20 rows for each query, sorted by the largest absolute z‑score in the row.  Output plain tables with the columns shown below.

**Plate‑level query**
```sql
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_cnt,
    AVG(NULLIF(u, -9999)) AS mean_u, STDDEV(NULLIF(u, -9999)) AS std_u,
    AVG(NULLIF(g, -9999)) AS mean_g, STDDEV(NULLIF(g, -9999)) AS std_g,
    AVG(NULLIF(r, -9999)) AS mean_r, STDDEV(NULLIF(r, -9999)) AS std_r,
    AVG(NULLIF(i, -9999)) AS mean_i, STDDEV(NULLIF(i, -9999)) AS std_i,
    AVG(NULLIF(z, -9999)) AS mean_z, STDDEV(NULLIF(z, -9999)) AS std_z,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class='GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS prop_gal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class='STAR'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS prop_star,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class='QSO'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS prop_qso
  FROM star_classification
),
plate_agg AS (
  SELECT
    plate,
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class='GALAXY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_gal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class='STAR'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_star,
    SUM(CASE WHEN class='QSO'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_qso,
    AVG(NULLIF(u, -9999)) AS mean_u,
    AVG(NULLIF(g, -9999)) AS mean_g,
    AVG(NULLIF(r, -9999)) AS mean_r,
    AVG(NULLIF(i, -9999)) AS mean_i,
    AVG(NULLIF(z, -9999)) AS mean_z,
    SUM(CASE WHEN u = -9999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS pct_missing_u,
    SUM(CASE WHEN g = -9999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS pct_missing_g,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z = -9999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS pct_missing_z
  FROM star_classification
  GROUP BY plate
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
)
SELECT
  p.plate,
  p.n,
  p.n_gal, p.n_star, p.n_qso,
  p.n_gal::DOUBLE/p.n AS gal_pct,
  p.n_star::DOUBLE/p.n AS star_pct,
  p.n_qso::DOUBLE/p.n AS qso_pct,
  -- Class proportion z‑scores
  (p.n_gal::DOUBLE/p.n - o.prop_gal)/SQRT(o.prop_gal*(1-o.prop_gal)/p.n) AS z_gal_pct,
  (p.n_star::DOUBLE/p.n - o.prop_star)/SQRT(o.prop_star*(1-o.prop_star)/p.n) AS z_star_pct,
  (p.n_qso::DOUBLE/p.n - o.prop_qso)/SQRT(o.prop_qso*(1-o.prop_qso)/p.n) AS z_qso_pct,
  -- Mean magnitude z‑scores
  (p.mean_u - o.mean_u)/o.std_u AS z_mean_u,
  (p.mean_g - o.mean_g)/o.std_g AS z_mean_g,
  (p.mean_r - o.mean_r)/o.std_r AS z_mean_r,
  (p.mean_i - o.mean_i)/o.std_i AS z_mean_i,
  (p.mean_z - o.mean_z)/o.std_z AS z_mean_z,
  p.pct_missing_u, p.pct_missing_g, p.pct_missing_z
FROM plate_agg p CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE ABS(z_gal_pct) > 2 OR ABS(z_star_pct) > 2 OR ABS(z_qso_pct) > 2
   OR ABS(z_mean_u) > 2 OR ABS(z_mean_g) > 2 OR ABS(z_mean_r) > 2
   OR ABS(z_mean_i) > 2 OR ABS(z_mean_z) > 2
   OR p.pct_missing_u > 0.5 OR p.pct_missing_g > 0.5 OR p.pct_missing_z > 0.5
ORDER BY GREATEST(ABS(z_gal_pct), ABS(z_star_pct), ABS(z_qso_pct), ABS(z_mean_u), ABS(z_mean_g), ABS(z_mean_r), ABS(z_mean_i), ABS(z_mean_z)) DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

    SUM(CASE WHEN z = -9999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS pct_missing_z

  f.fiber_ID,
  f.n,
  f.n_gal, f.n_star, f.n_qso,
  f.n_gal::DOUBLE/f.n AS gal_pct,
  f.n_star::DOUBLE/f.n AS star_pct,

WHERE ABS(z_gal_pct) > 2 OR ABS(z_star_pct) > 2 OR ABS(z_qso_pct) > 2
   OR ABS(z_mean_u) > 2 OR ABS(z_mean_g) > 2 OR ABS(z_mean_r) > 2

   OR f.pct_missing_u > 0.5 OR f.pct_missing_g > 0.5 OR f.pct_missing_z > 0.5
ORDER BY GREATEST(ABS(z_gal_pct), ABS(z_star_pct), ABS(z_qso_pct), ABS(z_mean_u), ABS(z_mean_g), ABS(z_mean_r), ABS(z_mean_i), ABS(z_mean_z)) DESC

WITH clean AS (
  SELECT
    class,
    redshift,
    (u - g) AS u_g,
    (g - r) AS g_r,
    (r - i) AS r_i,
    (i - z) AS i_z
  FROM star_classification
  WHERE u <> -9999
    AND g <> -9999
    AND z <> -9999
    AND redshift >= 0
)
SELECT class, metric, value FROM (
  -- Means
  SELECT class, 'redshift_mean' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(redshift),4) AS value FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL
  SELECT class, 'u-g_mean', ROUND(AVG(u_g),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL
  SELECT class, 'g-r_mean', ROUND(AVG(g_r),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL

WITH clean AS (
  SELECT
    class,
    redshift,
    (u - g) AS u_g,
    (g - r) AS g_r,
    (r - i) AS r_i,
    (i - z) AS i_z
  FROM star_classification
  WHERE u <> -9999
    AND g <> -9999
    AND z <> -9999
    AND redshift >= 0
)
SELECT class, metric, value FROM (
  -- Means
  SELECT class, 'redshift_mean' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(redshift),4) AS value FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL
  SELECT class, 'u-g_mean', ROUND(AVG(u_g),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL
  SELECT class, 'g-r_mean', ROUND(AVG(g_r),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL
  SELECT class, 'r-i_mean', ROUND(AVG(r_i),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL
  SELECT class, 'i-z_mean', ROUND(AVG(i_z),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  -- Stddev
  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'redshift_stddev', ROUND(STDDEV_POP(redshift),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'u-g_stddev', ROUND(STDDEV_POP(u_g),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'g-r_stddev', ROUND(STDDEV_POP(g_r),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'r-i_stddev', ROUND(STDDEV_POP(r_i),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'i-z_stddev', ROUND(STDDEV_POP(i_z),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  -- Min
  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'redshift_min', ROUND(MIN(redshift),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'u-g_min', ROUND(MIN(u_g),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'g-r_min', ROUND(MIN(g_r),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'r-i_min', ROUND(MIN(r_i),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'i-z_min', ROUND(MIN(i_z),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class

  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'redshift_max', ROUND(MAX(redshift),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'u-g_max', ROUND(MAX(u_g),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'g-r_max', ROUND(MAX(g_r),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'r-i_max', ROUND(MAX(r_i),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'i-z_max', ROUND(MAX(i_z),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class

  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'redshift_25p', ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY redshift),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class

  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'i-z_25p', ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY i_z),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class

  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'redshift_50p', ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY redshift),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class
  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'u-g_50p', ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u_g),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class

  UNION ALL SELECT class, 'i-z_75p', ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY i_z),4) FROM clean GROUP BY class

WITH clean_star AS (
  SELECT class, u, g, r, i, z, redshift
  FROM star_classification
  WHERE u <> -9999 AND g <> -9999 AND z <> -9999 AND redshift >= 0
),
median_cte AS (
  SELECT class, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY redshift) AS median_redshift
  FROM clean_star
  GROUP BY class
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT cs.*, m.median_redshift,
         CASE WHEN cs.redshift <= m.median_redshift THEN 'low_z' ELSE 'high_z' END AS group
  FROM clean_star cs
  JOIN median_cte m ON cs.class = m.class
),
agg AS (
  SELECT class, group,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         AVG(redshift) AS redshift_mean,
         STDDEV_POP(redshift) AS redshift_std,
         AVG(u - g) AS ug_mean,
         STDDEV_POP(u - g) AS ug_std,
         AVG(g - r) AS gr_mean,
         STDDEV_POP(g - r) AS gr_std,
         AVG(r - i) AS ri_mean,
         STDDEV_POP(r - i) AS ri_std,
         AVG(i - z) AS iz_mean,
         STDDEV_POP(i - z) AS iz_std
  FROM grouped
  GROUP BY class, group
)
SELECT class, group, 'count' AS metric, ROUND(cnt,4) AS value FROM agg
UNION ALL

CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW clean_star AS
SELECT class, u, g, r, i, z, redshift,
       u - g AS ug,
       g - r AS gr,
       r - i AS ri,
       i - z AS iz
FROM star_classification
WHERE u <> -9999 AND g <> -9999 AND z <> -9999 AND redshift >= 0;

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT class,
         COUNT(*) AS n,
         AVG(redshift) AS mean_redshift,
         STDDEV_SAMP(redshift) AS std_redshift,
         AVG(ug) AS mean_ug,
         STDDEV_SAMP(ug) AS std_ug,
         AVG(gr) AS mean_gr,
         STDDEV_SAMP(gr) AS std_gr,
         AVG(ri) AS mean_ri,
         STDDEV_SAMP(ri) AS std_ri,
         AVG(iz) AS mean_iz,
         STDDEV_SAMP(iz) AS std_iz
  FROM clean_star
  GROUP BY class
),
dev AS (
  SELECT class,
         (redshift - mean_redshift)*(ug - mean_ug) AS dev_redshift_ug,
         (redshift - mean_redshift)*(gr - mean_gr) AS dev_redshift_gr,
         (redshift - mean_redshift)*(ri - mean_ri) AS dev_redshift_ri,
         (redshift - mean_redshift)*(iz - mean_iz) AS dev_redshift_iz,
         (ug - mean_ug)*(gr - mean_gr) AS dev_ug_gr,
         (ug - mean_ug)*(ri - mean_ri) AS dev_ug_ri,
         (ug - mean_ug)*(iz - mean_iz) AS dev_ug_iz,
         (gr - mean_gr)*(ri - mean_ri) AS dev_gr_ri,
         (gr - mean_gr)*(iz - mean_iz) AS dev_gr_iz,
         (ri - mean_ri)*(iz - mean_iz) AS dev_ri_iz
  FROM clean_star
  JOIN stats USING (class)
),
cov AS (
  SELECT class,
         SUM(dev_redshift_ug)/n AS cov_redshift_ug,
         SUM(dev_redshift_gr)/n AS cov_redshift_gr,
         SUM(dev_redshift_ri)/n AS cov_redshift_ri,
         SUM(dev_redshift_iz)/n AS cov_redshift_iz,
         SUM(dev_ug_gr)/n AS cov_ug_gr,
         SUM(dev_ug_ri)/n AS cov_ug_ri,
         SUM(dev_ug_iz)/n AS cov_ug_iz,
         SUM(dev_gr_ri)/n AS cov_gr_ri,
         SUM(dev_gr_iz)/n AS cov_gr_iz,
         SUM(dev_ri_iz)/n AS cov_ri_iz
  FROM dev
  JOIN stats USING (class)
  GROUP BY class, n
),
corr AS (
  SELECT class,
         ROUND(cov_redshift_ug/(std_redshift*std_ug),4) AS corr_redshift_ug,
         ROUND(cov_redshift_gr/(std_redshift*std_gr),4) AS corr_redshift_gr,
         ROUND(cov_redshift_ri/(std_redshift*std_ri),4) AS corr_redshift_ri,
         ROUND(cov_redshift_iz/(std_redshift*std_iz),4) AS corr_redshift_iz,
         ROUND(cov_ug_gr/(std_ug*std_gr),4) AS corr_ug_gr,
         ROUND(cov_ug_ri/(std_ug*std_ri),4) AS corr_ug_ri,
         ROUND(cov_ug_iz/(std_ug*std_iz),4) AS corr_ug_iz,
         ROUND(cov_gr_ri/(std_gr*std_ri),4) AS corr_gr_ri,
         ROUND(cov_gr_iz/(std_gr*std_iz),4) AS corr_gr_iz,
         ROUND(cov_ri_iz/(std_ri*std_iz),4) AS corr_ri_iz
  FROM cov

)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW clean_star AS
SELECT class, u, g, r, i, z, redshift,
       u - g AS ug,
       g - r AS gr,
       r - i AS ri,
       i - z AS iz
FROM star_classification
WHERE u <> -9999 AND g <> -9999 AND z <> -9999 AND redshift >= 0;

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT class,
         COUNT(*) AS n,
         AVG(redshift) AS mean_redshift,
         STDDEV_SAMP(redshift) AS std_redshift,
         AVG(ug) AS mean_ug,
         STDDEV_SAMP(ug) AS std_ug,
         AVG(gr) AS mean_gr,
         STDDEV_SAMP(gr) AS std_gr,
         AVG(ri) AS mean_ri,
         STDDEV_SAMP(ri) AS std_ri,
         AVG(iz) AS mean_iz,
         STDDEV_SAMP(iz) AS std_iz
  FROM clean_star
  GROUP BY class
),
dev AS (
  SELECT class,
         (redshift - mean_redshift)*(ug - mean_ug) AS dev_redshift_ug,
         (redshift - mean_redshift)*(gr - mean_gr) AS dev_redshift_gr,
         (redshift - mean_redshift)*(ri - mean_ri) AS dev_redshift_ri,
         (redshift - mean_redshift)*(iz - mean_iz) AS dev_redshift_iz,
         (ug - mean_ug)*(gr - mean_gr) AS dev_ug_gr,
         (ug - mean_ug)*(ri - mean_ri) AS dev_ug_ri,
         (ug - mean_ug)*(iz - mean_iz) AS dev_ug_iz,
         (gr - mean_gr)*(ri - mean_ri) AS dev_gr_ri,
         (gr - mean_gr)*(iz - mean_iz) AS dev_gr_iz,
         (ri - mean_ri)*(iz - mean_iz) AS dev_ri_iz
  FROM clean_star
  JOIN stats USING (class)
),
cov AS (
  SELECT class,
         SUM(dev_redshift_ug)/n AS cov_redshift_ug,
         SUM(dev_redshift_gr)/n AS cov_redshift_gr,
         SUM(dev_redshift_ri)/n AS cov_redshift_ri,
         SUM(dev_redshift_iz)/n AS cov_redshift_iz,
         SUM(dev_ug_gr)/n AS cov_ug_gr,
         SUM(dev_ug_ri)/n AS cov_ug_ri,
         SUM(dev_ug_iz)/n AS cov_ug_iz,
         SUM(dev_gr_ri)/n AS cov_gr_ri,
         SUM(dev_gr_iz)/n AS cov_gr_iz,
         SUM(dev_ri_iz)/n AS cov_ri_iz
  FROM dev
  JOIN stats USING (class)
  GROUP BY class, n
),
corr AS (
  SELECT class,
         ROUND(cov_redshift_ug/(std_redshift*std_ug),4) AS corr_redshift_ug,
         ROUND(cov_redshift_gr/(std_redshift*std_gr),4) AS corr_redshift_gr,
         ROUND(cov_redshift_ri/(std_redshift*std_ri),4) AS corr_redshift_ri,
         ROUND(cov_redshift_iz/(std_redshift*std_iz),4) AS corr_redshift_iz,

         ROUND(cov_ri_iz/(std_ri*std_iz),4) AS corr_ri_iz
  FROM cov
  JOIN stats USING (class)
)

Create a temporary view `clean_star` with columns `class`, `u`, `g`, `r`, `i`, `z`, `redshift` and filters `u <> -9999`, `g <> -9999`, `z <> -9999`, `redshift >= 0`.  Add computed columns `ug = u - g`, `gr = g - r`, `ri = r - i`, `iz = i - z`.  For each `class` compute:

1. The 10th, 25th, 50th, 75th, and 90th percentiles of `ug` and `gr`.
2. A simple histogram of `ug` and `gr` with a bin width of 0.2: group by `class` and `floor(ug/0.2)*0.2` (call this `ug_bin`) and similarly for `gr`.  Return the count per bin.

Return a single table with columns: `class`, `metric`, `value`.  For the histogram part, use `metric` values like `ug_bin_0.0`, `ug_bin_0.2`, … and `gr_bin_…`.  Round all numeric values to 4 decimal places.  Do not compute any clustering or machine‑learning models.

WITH clean_star AS (
  SELECT class, u, g, r, i, z, redshift,
         u - g AS ug,
         g - r AS gr
  FROM star_classification
  WHERE u <> -9999 AND g <> -9999 AND z <> -9999 AND redshift >= 0
),
 hist AS (
  SELECT class,
         floor(ug/0.2)*0.2 AS ug_bin,
         floor(gr/0.2)*0.2 AS gr_bin,
         count(*) AS cnt
  FROM clean_star
  GROUP BY class, ug_bin, gr_bin
),
 mean_z AS (
  SELECT class,
         floor(ug/0.2)*0.2 AS ug_bin,
         avg(redshift) AS mean_z
  FROM clean_star
  GROUP BY class, ug_bin
)
SELECT class,
       format('ug_bin_%.1f_gr_bin_%.1f_count', ug_bin, gr_bin) AS metric,
       round(cnt,4) AS value
FROM hist
UNION ALL
SELECT class,
       format('ug_bin_%.1f_mean_redshift', ug_bin) AS metric,
       round(mean_z,4) AS value
FROM mean_z
ORDER BY class, metric;

message:
WITH clean_star AS (
  SELECT class, u, g, r, i, z, redshift,
         u - g AS ug,
         g - r AS gr,
         r - i AS ri,
         i - z AS iz
  FROM star_classification
  WHERE u <> -9999
    AND g <> -9999
    AND r <> -9999
    AND i <> -9999
    AND z <> -9999
    AND redshift >= 0
),
ug_hist AS (
  SELECT class,
         floor(ug/0.1)*0.1 AS bin,
         count(*) AS cnt,
         avg(redshift) AS mean_redshift,
         stddev_pop(redshift) AS stddev_redshift
  FROM clean_star
  GROUP BY class, bin
),
gr_hist AS (
  SELECT class,
         floor(gr/0.1)*0.1 AS bin,
         count(*) AS cnt,
         avg(redshift) AS mean_redshift,
         stddev_pop(redshift) AS stddev_redshift
  FROM clean_star
  GROUP BY class, bin
),
z_hist AS (
  SELECT class,
         floor(redshift/0.05)*0.05 AS bin,
         count(*) AS cnt,
         avg(redshift) AS mean_redshift,
         stddev_pop(redshift) AS stddev_redshift
  FROM clean_star
  GROUP BY class, bin
)
SELECT class,
       concat('ug_bin_', cast(bin as text), '_count') AS metric,
       round(cnt,4) AS value
FROM ug_hist
UNION ALL
SELECT class,
       concat('ug_bin_', cast(bin as text), '_mean_redshift'),
       round(mean_redshift,4)
FROM ug_hist
UNION ALL
SELECT class,
       concat('ug_bin_', cast(bin as text), '_stddev_redshift'),
       round(stddev_redshift,4)
FROM ug_hist
UNION ALL
SELECT class,
       concat('gr_bin_', cast(bin as text), '_count') AS metric,
       round(cnt,4)
FROM gr_hist
UNION ALL
SELECT class,
       concat('gr_bin_', cast(bin as text), '_mean_redshift'),
       round(mean_redshift,4)
FROM gr_hist
UNION ALL
SELECT class,
       concat('gr_bin_', cast(bin as text), '_stddev_redshift'),
       round(stddev_redshift,4)
FROM gr_hist
UNION ALL
SELECT class,
       concat('z_bin_', cast(bin as text), '_count') AS metric,
       round(cnt,4)
FROM z_hist
UNION ALL
SELECT class,
       concat('z_bin_', cast(bin as text), '_mean_redshift'),
       round(mean_redshift,4)
FROM z_hist
UNION ALL
SELECT class,
       concat('z_bin_', cast(bin as text), '_stddev_redshift'),
       round(stddev_redshift,4)
FROM z_hist
ORDER BY class, metric;

message:
WITH clean_star AS (
  SELECT class, u, g, r, i, z, redshift,
         (u - g) AS ug,
         (g - r) AS gr
  FROM star_classification
  WHERE u <> -9999 AND g <> -9999 AND r <> -9999 AND i <> -9999 AND z <> -9999
    AND redshift >= 0
)
SELECT class,
       ROUND(floor(ug/0.2)*0.2, 4) AS ug_bin,
       ROUND(floor(gr/0.2)*0.2, 4) AS gr_bin,
       COUNT(*) AS count,
       ROUND(AVG(redshift), 4) AS mean_redshift,
       ROUND(STDDEV_POP(redshift), 4) AS stddev_redshift
FROM clean_star
GROUP BY class, floor(ug/0.2)*0.2, floor(gr/0.2)*0.2
ORDER BY class, ug_bin, gr_bin;

  SELECT class, u, g, r, i, z, redshift,
         (u - g) AS ug,
         (g - r) AS gr
  FROM star_classification
  WHERE u <> -9999 AND g <> -9999 AND r <> -9999 AND i <> -9999 AND z <> -9999
    AND redshift >= 0
)
SELECT class,
       ROUND(floor(ug/0.2)*0.2, 4) AS ug_bin,
       ROUND(floor(gr/0.2)*0.2, 4) AS gr_bin,
       COUNT(*) AS count,
       ROUND(AVG(redshift), 4) AS mean_redshift,
       ROUND(STDDEV_POP(redshift), 4) AS stddev_redshift

WITH clean_star AS (
SELECT class, u, g, r, i, z, redshift,
       u - g AS ug,
       g - r AS gr,
       r - i AS ri,
       i - z AS iz
FROM star_classification
WHERE u <> -9999 AND g <> -9999 AND r <> -9999 AND i <> -9999 AND z <> -9999
  AND redshift >= 0
), bins AS (
SELECT class,
       floor(ug/0.1)*0.1 AS ug_bin,
       floor(gr/0.1)*0.1 AS gr_bin,
       count(*) AS cnt,
       avg(redshift) AS mean_redshift,
       stddev_pop(redshift) AS stddev_redshift
FROM clean_star
GROUP BY class, ug_bin, gr_bin
HAVING count(*) >= 50
)
SELECT class, ug_bin, gr_bin, cnt, round(mean_redshift,4) AS mean_redshift, round(stddev_redshift,4) AS stddev_redshift
FROM bins
ORDER BY class, ug_bin, gr_bin;

WITH clean_star AS (
  SELECT class, u, g, r, i, z, redshift,
         u - g AS ug,
         g - r AS gr,
         r - i AS ri,
         i - z AS iz
  FROM star_classification
  WHERE u <> -9999
    AND g <> -9999
    AND r <> -9999
    AND i <> -9999
    AND z <> -9999
    AND redshift >= 0
),
class_bounds AS (
  SELECT class,
         MIN(redshift) AS min_redshift,
         MAX(redshift) AS max_redshift,
         (MAX(redshift) - MIN(redshift)) / 20.0 AS bin_width
  FROM clean_star
  GROUP BY class
),
bins AS (
  SELECT cs.class,
         cs.redshift,
         cs.ug,
         cs.gr,
         cs.ri,
         cs.iz,
         cb.min_redshift,
         cb.max_redshift,
         cb.bin_width,
         CASE
           WHEN cb.bin_width = 0 THEN 0
           ELSE FLOOR((cs.redshift - cb.min_redshift) / cb.bin_width)
         END AS bin_index
  FROM clean_star cs
  JOIN class_bounds cb ON cs.class = cb.class
),
bin_counts AS (
  SELECT class,
         bin_index,
         MIN(redshift) AS bin_start,
         MIN(redshift) + bin_width AS bin_end,
         COUNT(*) AS count,
         AVG(redshift) AS mean_redshift
  FROM bins
  GROUP BY class, bin_index, bin_width
)
SELECT class,
       ROUND(bin_start,4) AS redshift_bin_start,
       ROUND(bin_end,4) AS redshift_bin_end,
       count,
       ROUND(mean_redshift,4) AS mean_redshift
FROM bin_counts
ORDER BY class, bin_index;

5. Round all numeric values to 4 decimal places.  
6. Return the three result sets as separate tables named `redshift_hist`, `ug_hist`, `gr_hist`.

2. For each `class`, compute a histogram of `redshift` using 20 equal‑width bins that span the min–max range of that class.  Return a table with columns: `class`, `redshift_bin_start`, `redshift_bin_end`, `count`, `mean_redshift`.  
3. For each `class`, compute a histogram of `ug` using 20 equal‑width bins over its min–max range, returning `class`, `ug_bin_start`, `ug_bin_end`, `count`, `mean_redshift`.  
4. For each `class`, compute a histogram of `gr` similarly, returning `class`, `gr_bin_start`, `gr_bin_end`, `count`, `mean_redshift`.  
5. Round all numeric values to 4 decimal places.  
6. Return the three result sets as separate tables named `redshift_hist`, `ug_hist`, `gr_hist`.

WITH clean_star AS (
  SELECT class, u, g, r, i, z, redshift,
         u - g AS ug,
         g - r AS gr,
         r - i AS ri,
         i - z AS iz
  FROM star_classification
  WHERE u <> -9999 AND g <> -9999 AND r <> -9999 AND i <> -9999 AND z <> -9999 AND redshift >= 0
),
class_bounds_gr AS (
  SELECT class,
         MIN(gr) AS min_gr,
         MAX(gr) AS max_gr,
         (MAX(gr) - MIN(gr)) / 20.0 AS bin_width
  FROM clean_star
  GROUP BY class
),
gr_bins AS (
  SELECT cs.class,
         cs.gr,
         cs.redshift,
         cb.min_gr,
         cb.max_gr,
         cb.bin_width,
         CASE
           WHEN cb.bin_width = 0 THEN 0
           ELSE FLOOR((cs.gr - cb.min_gr) / cb.bin_width)
         END AS bin_index
  FROM clean_star cs
  JOIN class_bounds_gr cb ON cs.class = cb.class
),
gr_bin_counts AS (
  SELECT class,
         bin_index,
         MIN(gr) AS bin_start,
         MIN(gr) + bin_width AS bin_end,
         COUNT(*) AS count,
         AVG(redshift) AS mean_redshift
  FROM gr_bins
  GROUP BY class, bin_index, bin_width
)
SELECT class,
       ROUND(bin_start,4) AS gr_bin_start,
       ROUND(bin_end,4) AS gr_bin_end,
       count,
       ROUND(mean_redshift,4) AS mean_redshift
FROM gr_bin_counts
ORDER BY class, bin_index;

3. For each `class`, compute a histogram of `ug` using 20 equal‑width bins over its min–max range, returning `class`, `ug_bin_start`, `ug_bin_end`, `count`, `mean_redshift`.  
4. For each `class`, compute a histogram of `gr` similarly, returning `class`, `gr_bin_start`, `gr_bin_end`, `count`, `mean_redshift`.  
5. Round all numeric values to 4 decimal places.  
6. Return the three result sets as separate tables named `redshift_hist`, `ug_hist`, `gr_hist`.

1. Create a temporary view `clean_star` with columns `class`, `u`, `g`, `r`, `i`, `z`, `redshift`.  Filter out rows where any of `u`, `g`, `r`, `i`, `z` equals -9999 or where `redshift` < 0.  Add computed columns `ug = u - g`, `gr = g - r`, `ri = r - i`, `iz = i - z`.  
2. For each `class`, compute a histogram of `redshift` using 20 equal‑width bins that span the min–max range of that class.  Return a table with columns: `class`, `redshift_bin_start`, `redshift_bin_end`, `count`, `mean_redshift`.  
3. For each `class`, compute a histogram of `ug` using 20 equal‑width bins over its min–max range, returning `class`, `ug_bin_start`, `ug_bin_end`, `count`, `mean_redshift`.  
4. For each `class`, compute a histogram of `gr` similarly, returning `class`, `gr_bin_start`, `gr_bin_end`, `count`, `mean_redshift`.  
5. Round all numeric values to 4 decimal places.  
6. Return the three result sets as separate tables named `redshift_hist`, `ug_hist`, `gr_hist`.

2. For each `class`, compute a histogram of `redshift` using 20 equal‑width bins that span the min–max range of that class.  Return a table with columns: `class`, `redshift_bin_start`, `redshift_bin_end`, `count`, `mean_redshift`.  
3. For each `class`, compute a histogram of `ug` using 20 equal‑width bins over its min–max range, returning `class`, `ug_bin_start`, `ug_bin_end`, `count`, `mean_redshift`.  
4. For each `class`, compute a histogram of `gr` similarly, returning `class`, `gr_bin_start`, `gr_bin_end`, `count`, `mean_redshift`.  
5. Round all numeric values to 4 decimal places.  
6. Return the three result sets as separate tables named `redshift_hist`, `ug_hist`, `gr_hist`.

1. Create a temporary view `clean_star` with columns `class`, `u`, `g`, `r`, `i`, `z`, `redshift`.  Filter out rows where any of `u`, `g`, `r`, `i`, `z` equals -9999 or where `redshift` < 0.  Add computed columns `ug = u - g`, `gr = g - r`, `ri = r - i`, `iz = i - z`.  
2. For each `class`, compute a histogram of `redshift` using 20 equal‑width bins that span the min–max range of that class.  Return a table with columns: `class`, `redshift_bin_start`, `redshift_bin_end`, `count`, `mean_redshift`.  
3. For each `class`, compute a histogram of `ug` using 20 equal‑width bins over its min–max range, returning `class`, `ug_bin_start`, `ug_bin_end`, `count`, `mean_redshift`.  
4. For each `class`, compute a histogram of `gr` similarly, returning `class`, `gr_bin_start`, `gr_bin_end`, `count`, `mean_redshift`.  
5. Round all numeric values to 4 decimal places.  
6. Return the three result sets as separate tables named `redshift_hist`, `ug_hist`, `gr_hist`.

1. Create a temporary view `clean_star` with columns `class`, `u`, `g`, `r`, `i`, `z`, `redshift`, and computed columns `ug = u - g`, `gr = g - r`, `ri = r - i`, `iz = i - z`.  Filter out rows where any of `u`, `g`, `r`, `i`, `z` equals -9999 or where `redshift` < 0.

2. Produce table `color_redshift_bins`:
   - GROUP BY `class`, `ug_bin = floor(ug/0.2)*0.2`, `gr_bin = floor(gr/0.2)*0.2`.
   - SELECT `class`, `ug_bin`, `gr_bin`, `count(*) AS count`, `round(avg(redshift),4) AS mean_redshift`, `round(stddev(redshift),4) AS stddev_redshift`.
   - HAVING `count(*) >= 50`.

3. Produce table `color_redshift_bins2`:
   - GROUP BY `class`, `ug_bin = floor(ug/0.2)*0.2`, `redshift_bin = floor(redshift/0.2)*0.2`.
   - SELECT `class`, `ug_bin`, `redshift_bin`, `count(*) AS count`, `round(avg(gr),4) AS mean_gr`, `round(stddev(gr),4) AS stddev_gr`.
   - HAVING `count(*) >= 50`.

4. Return the two result sets as separate tables named `color_redshift_bins` and `color_redshift_bins2`.

SELECT class, u, g, r, i, z, redshift,
       u - g AS ug,
       g - r AS gr,
       r - i AS ri,
       i - z AS iz
FROM star_classification
WHERE u <> -9999 AND g <> -9999 AND r <> -9999 AND i <> -9999 AND z <> -9999
  AND redshift >= 0;

message:
WITH clean_star AS (
  SELECT class, u, g, r, i, z, redshift,
         u - g AS ug,
         g - r AS gr,
         r - i AS ri,
         i - z AS iz
  FROM star_classification
  WHERE u <> -9999 AND g <> -9999 AND r <> -9999 AND i <> -9999 AND z <> -9999
    AND redshift >= 0
)
SELECT class,
       floor(ug/0.2)*0.2 AS ug_bin,
       floor(gr/0.2)*0.2 AS gr_bin,
       count(*) AS count,
       round(avg(redshift),4) AS mean_redshift,
       round(stddev_pop(redshift),4) AS stddev_redshift
FROM clean_star
GROUP BY class, ug_bin, gr_bin
HAVING count(*) >= 50
ORDER BY class, ug_bin, gr_bin;
